[150](#150)    fn emit_new(&mut self, node: &NewExpr, should_ignore_empty_args: bool) -> Result {
[151](#151)        self.wr.commit_pending_semi()?;
[152](#152)
[153](#153)        self.emit_leading_comments_of_span(node.span(), false)?;
[154](#154)
[155](#155)        srcmap!(self, node, true);
[156](#156)
[157](#157)        keyword!(self, "new");
[158](#158)
[159](#159)        let starts_with_alpha_num = node.callee.starts_with_alpha_num();
[160](#160)
[161](#161)        if starts_with_alpha_num {
[162](#162)            space!(self);
[163](#163)        } else {
[164](#164)            formatting_space!(self);
[165](#165)        }
[166](#166)        emit!(self, node.callee);
[167](#167)
[168](#168)        if let Some(type_args) = &node.type_args {
[169](#169)            emit!(self, type_args);
[170](#170)        }
[171](#171)
[172](#172)        if let Some(ref args) = node.args {
[173](#173)            if !(self.cfg.minify && args.is_empty() && should_ignore_empty_args) {
[174](#174)                punct!(self, "(");
[175](#175)                self.emit_expr_or_spreads(node.span(), args, ListFormat::NewExpressionArguments)?;
[176](#176)                punct!(self, ")");
[177](#177)            }
[178](#178)        }
[179](#179)
[180](#180)        if !should_ignore_empty_args && self.comments.is_some() {
[185](#185)            self.emit_trailing_comments_of_pos(node.span().hi, true, true)?;
[186](#186)        }
[187](#187)
[188](#188)        Ok(())
[189](#189)    }
[190](#190)
[191](#191)    fn emit_template_for_tagged_template(&mut self, node: &Tpl) -> Result {
[192](#192)        debug_assert!(node.quasis.len() == node.exprs.len() + 1);
[193](#193)
[194](#194)        self.emit_leading_comments_of_span(node.span(), false)?;
[195](#195)
[196](#196)        srcmap!(self, node, true);
[197](#197)
[198](#198)        punct!(self, "`");
[199](#199)
[200](#200)        for i in 0..(node.quasis.len() + node.exprs.len()) {
[201](#201)            if i % 2 == 0 {
[202](#202)                self.emit_template_element_for_tagged_template(&node.quasis[i / 2])?;
[203](#203)            } else {
[204](#204)                punct!(self, "${");
[205](#205)                emit!(self, node.exprs[i / 2]);
[206](#206)                punct!(self, "}");
[207](#207)            }
[208](#208)        }
[209](#209)
[210](#210)        punct!(self, "`");
[211](#211)
[212](#212)        srcmap!(self, node, false);
[213](#213)
[214](#214)        Ok(())
[215](#215)    }

[225](#225)    fn emit_bin_expr_trailing(&mut self, node: &BinExpr) -> Result {
[226](#226)        let is_kwd_op = match node.op {
[229](#229)            op!("in") | op!("instanceof") => true,
[230](#230)            _ => false,
[231](#231)        };
[232](#232)
[233](#233)        let need_pre_space = if self.cfg.minify {
[234](#234)            if is_kwd_op {
[235](#235)                node.left.ends_with_alpha_num()
[236](#236)            } else {
[237](#237)                match *node.left {
[239](#239)                    Expr::Update(UpdateExpr {
[240](#240)                        prefix: false, op, ..
[241](#241)                    }) => matches!(
[242](#242)                        (op, node.op),
[243](#243)                        (op!("--"), op!(">") | op!(">>") | op!(">>>") | op!(">="))
[244](#244)                    ),
[245](#245)                    _ => false,
[246](#246)                }
[247](#247)            }
[248](#248)        } else {
[249](#249)            is_kwd_op
[250](#250)                || match *node.left {
[251](#251)                    Expr::Update(UpdateExpr { prefix: false, .. }) => true,
[252](#252)                    _ => false,
[253](#253)                }
[254](#254)        };
[255](#255)        if need_pre_space {
[256](#256)            space!(self);
[257](#257)        } else {
[258](#258)            formatting_space!(self);
[259](#259)        }
[260](#260)        operator!(self, node.op.as_str());
[261](#261)
[262](#262)        let need_post_space = if self.cfg.minify {
[263](#263)            if is_kwd_op {
[264](#264)                node.right.starts_with_alpha_num()
[265](#265)            } else if node.op == op!("/") {
[266](#266)                let span = node.right.span();
[267](#267)
[268](#268)                span.is_pure()
[269](#269)                    || self
[270](#270)                        .comments
[271](#271)                        .is_some_and(|comments| comments.has_leading(node.right.span().lo))
[272](#272)            } else {
[273](#273)                require_space_before_rhs(&node.right, &node.op)
[274](#274)            }
[275](#275)        } else {
[276](#276)            is_kwd_op
[277](#277)                || match *node.right {
[278](#278)                    Expr::Unary(..) | Expr::Update(UpdateExpr { prefix: true, .. }) => true,
[279](#279)                    _ => false,
[280](#280)                }
[281](#281)        };
[282](#282)        if need_post_space {
[283](#283)            space!(self);
[284](#284)        } else {
[285](#285)            formatting_space!(self);
[286](#286)        }
[287](#287)        emit!(self, node.right);
[288](#288)
[289](#289)        Ok(())
[290](#290)    }
[291](#291)
[292](#292)    fn emit_fn_trailing(&mut self, node: &Function) -> Result {
[294](#294)        if let Some(type_params) = &node.type_params {
[295](#295)            emit!(self, type_params);
[296](#296)        }
[297](#297)
[298](#298)        punct!(self, "(");
[299](#299)        self.emit_list(node.span, Some(&node.params), ListFormat::CommaListElements)?;
[300](#300)        punct!(self, ")");
[301](#301)
[302](#302)        if let Some(ty) = &node.return_type {
[303](#303)            punct!(self, ":");
[304](#304)            formatting_space!(self);
[305](#305)            emit!(self, ty);
[306](#306)        }
[307](#307)
[308](#308)        if let Some(body) = &node.body {
[309](#309)            formatting_space!(self);
[310](#310)            self.emit_block_stmt_inner(body, true)?;
[311](#311)        } else {
[312](#312)            semi!(self);
[313](#313)        }
[314](#314)
[315](#315)        Ok(())
[316](#316)
[317](#317)        }

[339](#339)    fn emit_ident_like(&mut self, span: Span, sym: &Atom, optional: bool) -> Result {
[340](#340)        self.emit_leading_comments_of_span(span, false)?;
[342](#342)
[343](#343)        self.wr.commit_pending_semi()?;
[345](#345)
[346](#346)        srcmap!(self, span, true);
[347](#347)        if self.cfg.ascii_only {
[350](#350)            if self.wr.can_ignore_invalid_unicodes() {
[351](#351)                self.wr
[352](#352)                    .write_symbol(DUMMY_SP, &get_ascii_only_ident(sym, false, self.cfg.target))?;
[353](#353)            } else {
[354](#354)                self.wr.write_symbol(
[355](#355)                    DUMMY_SP,
[356](#356)                    &get_ascii_only_ident(&handle_invalid_unicodes(sym), false, self.cfg.target),
[357](#357)                )?;
[358](#358)            }
[359](#359)        } else if self.wr.can_ignore_invalid_unicodes() {
[360](#360)            self.wr.write_symbol(DUMMY_SP, sym)?;
[361](#361)        } else {
[362](#362)            self.wr
[363](#363)                .write_symbol(DUMMY_SP, &handle_invalid_unicodes(sym))?;
[364](#364)        }
[365](#365)
[366](#366)        if optional {
[367](#367)            punct!(self, "?");
[368](#368)        }
[369](#369)
[370](#370)        Ok(())
[376](#376)    }

[378](#378)    fn emit_list<N: Node>(
[379](#379)        &mut self,
[380](#380)        parent_node: Span,
[381](#381)        children: Option<&[N]>,
[382](#382)        format: ListFormat,
[383](#383)    ) -> Result {
[384](#384)        self.emit_list5(
[385](#385)            parent_node,
[386](#386)            children,
[387](#387)            format,
[388](#388)            0,
[389](#389)            children.map(|c| c.len()).unwrap_or(0),

[393](#393)    #[inline(never)]
[395](#395)    fn emit_first_of_list5(
[396](#396)        &mut self,
[397](#397)        parent_node: Span,
[398](#398)        children: Option<usize>,
[399](#399)        format: ListFormat,
[400](#400)        start: usize,
[401](#401)        count: usize,
[402](#402)    ) -> Option<Result> {
[403](#403)        if children.is_none() && format.contains(ListFormat::OptionalIfUndefined) {
[404](#404)            return Some(Ok(()));
[405](#405)        }
[406](#406)
[407](#407)        let is_empty = children.is_none() || start > children.unwrap() || count == 0;
[408](#408)        if is_empty && format.contains(ListFormat::OptionalIfEmpty) {
[409](#409)            return Some(Ok(()));
[410](#410)        }
[411](#411)
[412](#412)        if format.contains(ListFormat::BracketsMask) {
[413](#413)            if let Err(err) = self.wr.write_punct(None, format.opening_bracket()) {
[414](#414)                return Some(Err(err));
[415](#415)            }
[416](#416)
[417](#417)            if is_empty {
[418](#418)                if let Err(err) = self.emit_trailing_comments_of_pos(
[419](#419)                    {
[420](#420)                        parent_node.lo()
[423](#423)                    },
[424](#424)                    true,
[425](#425)                    false,
[426](#426)                ) {
[427](#427)                    return Some(Err(err));
[428](#428)                }
[429](#429)            }
[430](#430)        }
[431](#431)
[432](#432)        None
[433](#433)    }

[435](#435)    #[inline(never)]
[437](#437)    fn emit_pre_child_for_list5(
[438](#438)        &mut self,
[439](#439)        parent_node: Span,
[440](#440)        format: ListFormat,
[441](#441)        previous_sibling: Option<Span>,
[442](#442)        child: Span,
[443](#443)        should_decrease_indent_after_emit: &mut bool,
[444](#444)        should_emit_intervening_comments: &mut bool,
[445](#445)    ) -> Result {
[446](#446)        if let Some(previous_sibling) = previous_sibling {
[448](#448)            if format.contains(ListFormat::DelimitersMask)
[456](#456)                && previous_sibling.hi != parent_node.hi()
[457](#457)                && self.comments.is_some()
[458](#458)            {
[459](#459)                self.emit_leading_comments(previous_sibling.hi(), true)?;
[460](#460)            }
[461](#461)
[462](#462)            self.write_delim(format)?;
[463](#463)
[464](#464)            if self.cm.should_write_separating_line_terminator(
[467](#467)                Some(previous_sibling),
[468](#468)                Some(child),
[469](#469)                format,
[470](#470)            ) {
[471](#471)                if (format & (ListFormat::LinesMask | ListFormat::Indented))
[474](#474)                    == ListFormat::SingleLine
[475](#475)                    && !self.cfg.minify
[476](#476)                {
[477](#477)                    self.wr.increase_indent()?;
[478](#478)                    *should_decrease_indent_after_emit = true;
[479](#479)                }
[480](#480)
[481](#481)                if !self.cfg.minify {
[482](#482)                    self.wr.write_line()?;
[483](#483)                }
[484](#484)                *should_emit_intervening_comments = false;
[485](#485)            } else if format.contains(ListFormat::SpaceBetweenSiblings) {
[486](#486)                formatting_space!(self);
[487](#487)            }
[488](#488)        }
[489](#489)
[490](#490)        Ok(())
[491](#491)    }

[493](#493)    #[inline(never)]
[495](#495)    fn emit_list_finisher_of_list5(
[496](#496)        &mut self,
[497](#497)        parent_node: Span,
[498](#498)        format: ListFormat,
[499](#499)        previous_sibling: Option<Span>,
[500](#500)        last_child: Option<Span>,
[501](#501)    ) -> Result {
[502](#502)        let has_trailing_comma = format.contains(ListFormat::ForceTrailingComma)
[504](#504)            || format.contains(ListFormat::AllowTrailingComma) && {
[505](#505)                if parent_node.is_dummy() {
[506](#506)                    false
[507](#507)                } else {
[508](#508)                    match self.cm.span_to_snippet(parent_node) {
[509](#509)                        Ok(snippet) => {
[510](#510)                            if snippet.len() < 3 {
[511](#511)                                false
[512](#512)                            } else {
[513](#513)                                let last_char = snippet.chars().last().unwrap();
[514](#514)                                snippet[..snippet.len() - last_char.len_utf8()]
[515](#515)                                    .trim()
[516](#516)                                    .ends_with(',')
[517](#517)                            }
[518](#518)                        }
[519](#519)                        _ => false,
[520](#520)                    }
[521](#521)                }
[522](#522)            };
[523](#523)
[524](#524)        if has_trailing_comma
[525](#525)            && format.contains(ListFormat::CommaDelimited)
[526](#526)            && (!self.cfg.minify || !format.contains(ListFormat::CanSkipTrailingComma))
[527](#527)        {
[528](#528)            punct!(self, ",");
[529](#529)            formatting_space!(self);
[530](#530)        }
[531](#531)
[532](#532)        {
[533](#533)            let emit_trailing_comments = {
[541](#541)                true
[546](#546)            };
[547](#547)
[548](#548)            if let Some(previous_sibling) = previous_sibling {
[549](#549)                if format.contains(ListFormat::DelimitersMask)
[550](#550)                    && previous_sibling.hi() != parent_node.hi()
[551](#551)                    && emit_trailing_comments
[552](#552)                    && self.comments.is_some()
[553](#553)                {
[554](#554)                    self.emit_leading_comments(previous_sibling.hi(), true)?;
[555](#555)                }
[556](#556)            }
[557](#557)        }
[558](#558)
[559](#559)        if format.contains(ListFormat::Indented) && !self.cfg.minify {
[561](#561)            self.wr.decrease_indent()?;
[562](#562)        }
[563](#563)
[564](#564)        if self
[566](#566)            .cm
[567](#567)            .should_write_closing_line_terminator(parent_node, last_child, format)
[568](#568)        {
[569](#569)            if !self.cfg.minify {
[570](#570)                self.wr.write_line()?;
[571](#571)            }
[572](#572)        } else if format.contains(ListFormat::SpaceBetweenBraces) && !self.cfg.minify {
[573](#573)            self.wr.write_space()?;
[574](#574)        }
[575](#575)
[576](#576)        Ok(())
[577](#577)    }
[578](#578)
[579](#579)    #[inline(never)]
[581](#581)    fn emit_last_of_list5(
[582](#582)        &mut self,
[583](#583)        parent_node: Span,
[584](#584)        is_empty: bool,
[585](#585)        format: ListFormat,
[586](#586)        _start: usize,
[587](#587)        _count: usize,
[588](#588)    ) -> Result {
[589](#589)        if format.contains(ListFormat::BracketsMask) {
[590](#590)            if is_empty {
[591](#591)                self.emit_leading_comments(
[592](#592)                    {
[593](#593)                        parent_node.hi()
[596](#596)                    },
[597](#597)                    true,
[598](#598)                )?; }
[600](#600)            self.wr.write_punct(None, format.closing_bracket())?;
[601](#601)        }
[602](#602)
[603](#603)        Ok(())
[604](#604)    }
[605](#605)
[606](#606)    fn emit_list5<N: Node>(
[607](#607)        &mut self,
[608](#608)        parent_node: Span,
[609](#609)        children: Option<&[N]>,
[610](#610)        format: ListFormat,
[611](#611)        start: usize,
[612](#612)        count: usize,
[613](#613)    ) -> Result {
[614](#614)        if let Some(result) =
[615](#615)            self.emit_first_of_list5(parent_node, children.map(|v| v.len()), format, start, count)
[616](#616)        {
[617](#617)            return result;
[618](#618)        }
[619](#619)
[620](#620)        let is_empty = children.is_none() || start > children.unwrap().len() || count == 0;
[621](#621)
[622](#622)        if is_empty {
[623](#623)            if format.contains(ListFormat::MultiLine) {
[626](#626)                if !self.cfg.minify {
[627](#627)                    self.wr.write_line()?;
[628](#628)                }
[629](#629)            } else if format.contains(ListFormat::SpaceBetweenBraces)
[630](#630)                && !(format.contains(ListFormat::NoSpaceIfEmpty))
[631](#631)                && !self.cfg.minify
[632](#632)            {
[633](#633)                self.wr.write_space()?;
[634](#634)            }
[635](#635)        } else {
[636](#636)            let children = children.unwrap();
[637](#637)
[638](#638)            let may_emit_intervening_comments =
[640](#640)                !format.intersects(ListFormat::NoInterveningComments);
[641](#641)            let mut should_emit_intervening_comments = may_emit_intervening_comments;
[642](#642)            if self.cm.should_write_leading_line_terminator(
[643](#643)                parent_node,
[644](#644)                children.first().map(|v| v.span()),
[645](#645)                format,
[646](#646)            ) {
[647](#647)                if !self.cfg.minify {
[648](#648)                    self.wr.write_line()?;
[649](#649)                }
[650](#650)                should_emit_intervening_comments = false;
[651](#651)            } else if format.contains(ListFormat::SpaceBetweenBraces) && !self.cfg.minify {
[652](#652)                self.wr.write_space()?;
[653](#653)            }
[654](#654)
[655](#655)            if format.contains(ListFormat::Indented) && !self.cfg.minify {
[657](#657)                self.wr.increase_indent()?;
[658](#658)            }
[659](#659)
[660](#660)            let mut previous_sibling: Option<Span> = None;
[662](#662)            let mut should_decrease_indent_after_emit = false;
[663](#663)            for i in 0..count {
[664](#664)                let child = &children[start + i];
[665](#665)
[666](#666)                self.emit_pre_child_for_list5(
[667](#667)                    parent_node,
[668](#668)                    format,
[669](#669)                    previous_sibling,
[670](#670)                    child.span(),
[671](#671)                    &mut should_decrease_indent_after_emit,
[672](#672)                    &mut should_emit_intervening_comments,
[673](#673)                )?;
[674](#674)
[675](#675)                child.emit_with(self)?;
[676](#676)
[677](#677)                if should_emit_intervening_comments {
[679](#679)                    if self.comments.is_some() {
[680](#680)                        let comment_range = child.comment_range();
[681](#681)                        self.emit_trailing_comments_of_pos(comment_range.hi(), false, true)?;
[682](#682)                    }
[683](#683)                } else {
[684](#684)                    should_emit_intervening_comments = may_emit_intervening_comments;
[685](#685)                }
[686](#686)
[687](#687)                if should_decrease_indent_after_emit {
[688](#688)                    self.wr.decrease_indent()?;
[689](#689)                    should_decrease_indent_after_emit = false;
[690](#690)                }
[691](#691)
[692](#692)                previous_sibling = Some(child.span());
[693](#693)            }
[694](#694)
[695](#695)            self.emit_list_finisher_of_list5(
[696](#696)                parent_node,
[697](#697)                format,
[698](#698)                previous_sibling,
[699](#699)                children.last().map(|v| v.span()),
[700](#700)            )?;
[701](#701)        }
[702](#702)
[703](#703)        self.emit_last_of_list5(parent_node, is_empty, format, start, count)?;
[706](#706)        Ok(())
[707](#707)    }
[708](#708)}
[709](#709)
[710](#710)impl<W, S: SourceMapper> Emitter<'_, W, S>

[716](#716)    fn emit_block_stmt_inner(&mut self, node: &BlockStmt, skip_first_src_map: bool) -> Result {
[717](#717)        self.emit_leading_comments_of_span(node.span(), false)?;
[718](#718)
[719](#719)        if !skip_first_src_map {
[720](#720)            srcmap!(self, node, true);
[721](#721)        }
[722](#722)        punct!(self, "{");
[723](#723)
[724](#724)        let emit_new_line = !self.cfg.minify
[725](#725)            && !(node.stmts.is_empty() && is_empty_comments(&node.span(), &self.comments));
[726](#726)
[727](#727)        let mut list_format = ListFormat::MultiLineBlockStatements;
[728](#728)
[729](#729)        if !emit_new_line {
[730](#730)            list_format -= ListFormat::MultiLine | ListFormat::Indented;
[731](#731)        }
[732](#732)
[733](#733)        self.emit_list(node.span(), Some(&node.stmts), list_format)?;
[734](#734)
[735](#735)        self.emit_leading_comments_of_span(node.span(), true)?;
[736](#736)
[737](#737)        srcmap!(self, node, false, true);
[738](#738)        punct!(self, "}");
[739](#739)
[740](#740)        Ok(())
[741](#741)    }
[742](#742)
[743](#743)    fn has_trailing_comment(&self, span: Span) -> bool {
[744](#744)        if let Some(cmt) = self.comments {
[745](#745)            let hi = span.hi;
[746](#746)
[747](#747)            if cmt.has_trailing(hi) {
[748](#748)                return true;
[749](#749)            }
[750](#750)        }
[751](#751)
[752](#752)        false
[753](#753)    }
[754](#754)
[755](#755)    fn simple_assign_target_has_leading_comment(&self, arg: &SimpleAssignTarget) -> bool {
[756](#756)        match arg {
[757](#757)            SimpleAssignTarget::Ident(i) => {
[758](#758)                span_has_leading_comment(self.comments.as_ref().unwrap(), i.span)
[759](#759)            }
[760](#760)            SimpleAssignTarget::Member(m) => {
[761](#761)                if self.has_leading_comment(&m.obj) {
[762](#762)                    return true;
[763](#763)                }
[764](#764)
[765](#765)                false
[766](#766)            }
[767](#767)
[768](#768)            SimpleAssignTarget::SuperProp(m) => {
[769](#769)                if span_has_leading_comment(self.comments.as_ref().unwrap(), m.span) {
[770](#770)                    return true;
[771](#771)                }
[772](#772)
[773](#773)                false
[774](#774)            }
[775](#775)
[776](#776)            _ => false,
[777](#777)        }
[778](#778)    }
[779](#779)
[780](#780)    fn has_leading_comment(&self, arg: &Expr) -> bool {
[781](#781)        let cmt = if let Some(cmt) = self.comments {
[782](#782)            if span_has_leading_comment(cmt, arg.span()) {
[783](#783)                return true;
[784](#784)            }
[785](#785)
[786](#786)            cmt
[787](#787)        } else {
[788](#788)            return false;
[789](#789)        };
[790](#790)
[791](#791)        match arg {
[792](#792)            Expr::Call(c) => {
[793](#793)                let has_leading = match &c.callee {
[794](#794)                    Callee::Super(callee) => span_has_leading_comment(cmt, callee.span),
[795](#795)                    Callee::Import(callee) => span_has_leading_comment(cmt, callee.span),
[796](#796)                    Callee::Expr(callee) => self.has_leading_comment(callee),
[797](#797)                    #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[798](#798)                    _ => false,
[799](#799)                };
[800](#800)
[801](#801)                if has_leading {
[802](#802)                    return true;
[803](#803)                }
[804](#804)            }
[805](#805)
[806](#806)            Expr::Member(m) => {
[807](#807)                if self.has_leading_comment(&m.obj) {
[808](#808)                    return true;
[809](#809)                }
[810](#810)            }
[811](#811)
[812](#812)            Expr::SuperProp(m) => {
[813](#813)                if span_has_leading_comment(cmt, m.span) {
[814](#814)                    return true;
[815](#815)                }
[816](#816)            }
[817](#817)
[818](#818)            Expr::Bin(e) => {
[819](#819)                if self.has_leading_comment(&e.left) {
[820](#820)                    return true;
[821](#821)                }
[822](#822)            }
[823](#823)
[824](#824)            Expr::Cond(e) => {
[825](#825)                if self.has_leading_comment(&e.test) {
[826](#826)                    return true;
[827](#827)                }
[828](#828)            }
[829](#829)
[830](#830)            Expr::Seq(e) => {
[831](#831)                if let Some(e) = e.exprs.first() {
[832](#832)                    if self.has_leading_comment(e) {
[833](#833)                        return true;
[834](#834)                    }
[835](#835)                }
[836](#836)            }
[837](#837)
[838](#838)            Expr::Assign(e) => {
[839](#839)                let lo = e.span.lo;
[840](#840)
[841](#841)                if cmt.has_leading(lo) {
[842](#842)                    return true;
[843](#843)                }
[844](#844)
[845](#845)                let has_leading = match &e.left {
[846](#846)                    AssignTarget::Simple(e) => self.simple_assign_target_has_leading_comment(e),
[847](#847)
[848](#848)                    AssignTarget::Pat(p) => match p {
[849](#849)                        AssignTargetPat::Array(a) => span_has_leading_comment(cmt, a.span),
[850](#850)                        AssignTargetPat::Object(o) => span_has_leading_comment(cmt, o.span),
[851](#851)                        AssignTargetPat::Invalid(..) => false,
[852](#852)                        #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[853](#853)                        _ => false,
[854](#854)                    },
[855](#855)                    #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[856](#856)                    _ => false,
[857](#857)                };
[858](#858)
[859](#859)                if has_leading {
[860](#860)                    return true;
[861](#861)                }
[862](#862)            }
[863](#863)
[864](#864)            Expr::OptChain(e) => match &*e.base {
[865](#865)                OptChainBase::Member(m) => {
[866](#866)                    if self.has_leading_comment(&m.obj) {
[867](#867)                        return true;
[868](#868)                    }
[869](#869)                }
[870](#870)                OptChainBase::Call(c) => {
[871](#871)                    if self.has_leading_comment(&c.callee) {
[872](#872)                        return true;
[873](#873)                    }
[874](#874)                }
[875](#875)                #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[876](#876)                _ => (),
[877](#877)            },
[878](#878)
[879](#879)            _ => {}
[880](#880)        }
[881](#881)
[882](#882)        false
[883](#883)    }

[886](#886)impl<W, S: SourceMapper> Emitter<'_, W, S>

[891](#891)    fn write_delim(&mut self, f: ListFormat) -> Result {
[892](#892)        match f & ListFormat::DelimitersMask {
[893](#893)            ListFormat::None => {}
[894](#894)            ListFormat::CommaDelimited => self.wr.write_punct(None, ",")?,
[895](#895)            ListFormat::BarDelimited => {
[896](#896)                if !self.cfg.minify {
[897](#897)                    self.wr.write_space()?;
[898](#898)                }
[899](#899)                self.wr.write_punct(None, "|")?;
[900](#900)            }
[901](#901)            ListFormat::AmpersandDelimited => {
[902](#902)                if !self.cfg.minify {
[903](#903)                    self.wr.write_space()?;
[904](#904)                }
[905](#905)                self.wr.write_punct(None, "&")?;
[906](#906)            }
[907](#907)            _ => unreachable!(),
[908](#908)        }
[909](#909)
[910](#910)        Ok(())
[911](#911)    }

[913](#913)
[914](#914)fn should_emit_whitespace_before_operand(node: &UnaryExpr) -> bool {
[929](#929)    match *node {
[930](#930)        UnaryExpr {
[931](#931)            op: op!("void"), ..
[932](#932)        }
[933](#933)        | UnaryExpr {
[934](#934)            op: op!("typeof"), ..
[935](#935)        }
[936](#936)        | UnaryExpr {
[937](#937)            op: op!("delete"), ..
[938](#938)        } => return node.arg.starts_with_alpha_num(),
[939](#939)        _ => {}
[940](#940)    }
[941](#941)
[942](#942)    match &*node.arg {
[943](#943)        Expr::Update(UpdateExpr {
[944](#944)            op: op!("++"),
[945](#945)            prefix: true,
[946](#946)            ..
[947](#947)        })
[948](#948)        | Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[949](#949)            op: op!(unary, "+"),
[950](#950)            ..
[951](#951)        }) if node.op == op!(unary, "+") => true,
[952](#952)        Expr::Update(UpdateExpr {
[953](#953)            op: op!("--"),
[954](#954)            prefix: true,
[955](#955)            ..
[956](#956)        })
[957](#957)        | Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[958](#958)            op: op!(unary, "-"),
[959](#959)            ..
[960](#960)        }) if node.op == op!(unary, "-") => true,
[961](#961)
[962](#962)        Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(v)) if v.value.is_sign_negative() && node.op == op!(unary, "-") => true,
[963](#963)
[964](#964)        _ => false,
[965](#965)    }

[983](#983)
[984](#984)fn get_template_element_from_raw(
[985](#985)    s: &str,
[986](#986)    ascii_only: bool,
[987](#987)    reduce_escaped_newline: bool,
[988](#988)) -> String {
[989](#989)    fn read_escaped(
[990](#990)        radix: u32,
[991](#991)        len: Option<usize>,
[992](#992)        buf: &mut String,
[993](#993)        iter: impl Iterator<Item = char>,
[994](#994)    ) {
[995](#995)        let mut v = 0;
[996](#996)        let mut pending = None;
[997](#997)
[998](#998)        for (i, c) in iter.enumerate() {
[999](#999)            if let Some(len) = len {
[1000](#1000)                if i == len {
[1001](#1001)                    pending = Some(c);
[1002](#1002)                    break;
[1003](#1003)                }
[1004](#1004)            }
[1005](#1005)
[1006](#1006)            match c.to_digit(radix) {
[1007](#1007)                None => {
[1008](#1008)                    pending = Some(c);
[1009](#1009)                    break;
[1010](#1010)                }
[1011](#1011)                Some(d) => {
[1012](#1012)                    v = v * radix + d;
[1013](#1013)                }
[1014](#1014)            }
[1015](#1015)        }
[1016](#1016)
[1017](#1017)        match radix {
[1018](#1018)            16 => {
[1019](#1019)                match v {
[1020](#1020)                    0 => match pending {
[1021](#1021)                        Some('1'..='9') => write!(buf, "\\x00").unwrap(),
[1022](#1022)                        _ => write!(buf, "\\0").unwrap(),
[1023](#1023)                    },
[1024](#1024)                    1..=15 => write!(buf, "\\x0{v:x}").unwrap(),
[1025](#1025)                    32..=126 => {
[1027](#1027)                        let c = char::from_u32(v);
[1028](#1028)
[1029](#1029)                        match c {
[1030](#1030)                            Some(c) => write!(buf, "{c}").unwrap(),
[1031](#1031)                            _ => {
[1032](#1032)                                unreachable!()
[1033](#1033)                            }
[1034](#1034)                        }
[1035](#1035)                    }
[1036](#1036)                    _ => {
[1039](#1039)                        write!(buf, "\\x{v:x}").unwrap();
[1040](#1040)                    }
[1041](#1041)                }
[1042](#1042)            }
[1043](#1043)
[1044](#1044)            _ => unreachable!(),
[1045](#1045)        }
[1046](#1046)
[1047](#1047)        if let Some(pending) = pending {
[1048](#1048)            buf.push(pending);
[1049](#1049)        }
[1050](#1050)    }
[1051](#1051)
[1052](#1052)    let mut buf = String::with_capacity(s.len());
[1053](#1053)    let mut iter = s.chars().peekable();
[1054](#1054)
[1055](#1055)    let mut is_dollar_prev = false;
[1056](#1056)
[1057](#1057)    while let Some(c) = iter.next() {
[1058](#1058)        let unescape = match c {
[1059](#1059)            '\\' => match iter.next() {
[1060](#1060)                Some(c) => match c {
[1061](#1061)                    'n' => {
[1062](#1062)                        if reduce_escaped_newline {
[1063](#1063)                            Some('\n')
[1064](#1064)                        } else {
[1065](#1065)                            buf.push('\\');
[1066](#1066)                            buf.push('n');
[1067](#1067)
[1068](#1068)                            None
[1069](#1069)                        }
[1070](#1070)                    }
[1071](#1071)                    't' => Some('\t'),
[1072](#1072)                    'x' => {
[1073](#1073)                        read_escaped(16, Some(2), &mut buf, &mut iter);
[1074](#1074)
[1075](#1075)                        None
[1076](#1076)                    }
[1077](#1077)                    '\u{2028}' | '\u{2029}' => None,
[1080](#1080)                    '\\' | 'r' | 'v' | 'b' | 'f' | 'u' | '\r' | '\n' | '`' | '0'..='7' => {
[1083](#1083)                        buf.push('\\');
[1084](#1084)                        buf.push(c);
[1085](#1085)
[1086](#1086)                        None
[1087](#1087)                    }
[1088](#1088)                    '$' if iter.peek() == Some(&'{') => {
[1089](#1089)                        buf.push('\\');
[1090](#1090)                        buf.push('$');
[1091](#1091)
[1092](#1092)                        None
[1093](#1093)                    }
[1094](#1094)                    '{' if is_dollar_prev => {
[1095](#1095)                        buf.push('\\');
[1096](#1096)                        buf.push('{');
[1097](#1097)
[1098](#1098)                        is_dollar_prev = false;
[1099](#1099)
[1100](#1100)                        None
[1101](#1101)                    }
[1102](#1102)                    _ => Some(c),
[1103](#1103)                },
[1104](#1104)                None => Some('\\'),
[1105](#1105)            },
[1106](#1106)            _ => Some(c),
[1107](#1107)        };
[1108](#1108)
[1109](#1109)        match unescape {
[1110](#1110)            Some(c @ '$') => {
[1111](#1111)                is_dollar_prev = true;
[1112](#1112)
[1113](#1113)                buf.push(c);
[1114](#1114)            }
[1115](#1115)            Some('\x00') => {
[1116](#1116)                let next = iter.peek();
[1117](#1117)
[1118](#1118)                match next {
[1119](#1119)                    Some('1'..='9') => buf.push_str("\\x00"),
[1120](#1120)                    _ => buf.push_str("\\0"),
[1121](#1121)                }
[1122](#1122)            }
[1123](#1123)            Some('\u{0008}') => buf.push_str("\\b"),
[1126](#1126)            Some('\u{000c}') => buf.push_str("\\f"),
[1127](#1127)            Some('\n') => buf.push('\n'),
[1128](#1128)            Some('\u{000b}') => buf.push_str("\\v"),
[1130](#1130)            Some('\t') => buf.push('\t'),
[1131](#1131)            Some(c @ '\x20'..='\x7e') => {
[1133](#1133)                buf.push(c);
[1134](#1134)            }
[1135](#1135)            Some(c @ '\u{7f}'..='\u{ff}') => {
[1136](#1136)                let _ = write!(buf, "\\x{:x}", c as u8);
[1137](#1137)            }
[1138](#1138)            Some('\u{2028}') => {
[1139](#1139)                buf.push_str("\\u2028");
[1140](#1140)            }
[1141](#1141)            Some('\u{2029}') => {
[1142](#1142)                buf.push_str("\\u2029");
[1143](#1143)            }
[1144](#1144)            Some('\u{FEFF}') => {
[1145](#1145)                buf.push_str("\\uFEFF");
[1146](#1146)            }
[1147](#1147)            Some(c) => {
[1149](#1149)                if !ascii_only || c.is_ascii() {
[1150](#1150)                    buf.push(c);
[1151](#1151)                } else {
[1152](#1152)                    buf.extend(c.escape_unicode().map(|c| {
[1153](#1153)                        if c == 'u' {
[1154](#1154)                            c
[1155](#1155)                        } else {
[1156](#1156)                            c.to_ascii_uppercase()
[1157](#1157)                        }
[1158](#1158)                    }));
[1159](#1159)                }
[1160](#1160)            }
[1161](#1161)            None => {}
[1162](#1162)        }
[1163](#1163)    }
[1164](#1164)
[1165](#1165)    buf
[1166](#1166)}
[1167](#1167)
[1168](#1168)fn get_ascii_only_ident(sym: &str, may_need_quote: bool, target: EsVersion) -> CowStr {
[1169](#1169)    if sym.is_ascii() {
[1170](#1170)        return CowStr::Borrowed(sym);
[1171](#1171)    }
[1172](#1172)
[1173](#1173)    let mut first = true;
[1174](#1174)    let mut buf = CompactString::with_capacity(sym.len() + 8);
[1175](#1175)    let mut iter = sym.chars().peekable();
[1176](#1176)    let mut need_quote = false;
[1177](#1177)
[1178](#1178)    while let Some(c) = iter.next() {
[1179](#1179)        match c {
[1180](#1180)            '\x00' => {
[1181](#1181)                if may_need_quote {
[1182](#1182)                    need_quote = true;
[1183](#1183)                    let _ = write!(buf, "\\x00");
[1184](#1184)                } else {
[1185](#1185)                    let _ = write!(buf, "\\u0000");
[1186](#1186)                }
[1187](#1187)            }
[1188](#1188)            '\u{0008}' => buf.push_str("\\b"),
[1189](#1189)            '\u{000c}' => buf.push_str("\\f"),
[1190](#1190)            '\n' => buf.push_str("\\n"),
[1191](#1191)            '\r' => buf.push_str("\\r"),
[1192](#1192)            '\u{000b}' => buf.push_str("\\v"),
[1193](#1193)            '\t' => buf.push('\t'),
[1194](#1194)            '\\' => {
[1195](#1195)                let next = iter.peek();
[1196](#1196)
[1197](#1197)                match next {
[1198](#1198)                    Some('u') => {
[1200](#1200)                        let mut inner_iter = iter.clone();
[1201](#1201)
[1202](#1202)                        inner_iter.next();
[1203](#1203)
[1204](#1204)                        let mut is_curly = false;
[1205](#1205)                        let mut next = inner_iter.peek();
[1206](#1206)
[1207](#1207)                        if next == Some(&'{') {
[1208](#1208)                            is_curly = true;
[1209](#1209)
[1210](#1210)                            inner_iter.next();
[1211](#1211)                            next = inner_iter.peek();
[1212](#1212)                        }
[1213](#1213)
[1214](#1214)                        if let Some(c @ 'D' | c @ 'd') = next {
[1215](#1215)                            let mut inner_buf = String::new();
[1216](#1216)
[1217](#1217)                            inner_buf.push('\\');
[1218](#1218)                            inner_buf.push('u');
[1219](#1219)
[1220](#1220)                            if is_curly {
[1221](#1221)                                inner_buf.push('{');
[1222](#1222)                            }
[1223](#1223)
[1224](#1224)                            inner_buf.push(*c);
[1225](#1225)
[1226](#1226)                            inner_iter.next();
[1227](#1227)
[1228](#1228)                            let mut is_valid = true;
[1229](#1229)
[1230](#1230)                            for _ in 0..3 {
[1231](#1231)                                let c = inner_iter.next();
[1232](#1232)
[1233](#1233)                                match c {
[1234](#1234)                                    Some('0'..='9') | Some('a'..='f') | Some('A'..='F') => {
[1235](#1235)                                        inner_buf.push(c.unwrap());
[1236](#1236)                                    }
[1237](#1237)                                    _ => {
[1238](#1238)                                        is_valid = false;
[1239](#1239)
[1240](#1240)                                        break;
[1241](#1241)                                    }
[1242](#1242)                                }
[1243](#1243)                            }
[1244](#1244)
[1245](#1245)                            if is_curly {
[1246](#1246)                                inner_buf.push('}');
[1247](#1247)                            }
[1248](#1248)
[1249](#1249)                            if is_valid {
[1250](#1250)                                buf.push_str(&inner_buf);
[1251](#1251)
[1252](#1252)                                let end = if is_curly { 7 } else { 5 };
[1253](#1253)
[1254](#1254)                                for _ in 0..end {
[1255](#1255)                                    iter.next();
[1256](#1256)                                }
[1257](#1257)                            }
[1258](#1258)                        } else {
[1259](#1259)                            buf.push_str("\\\\");
[1260](#1260)                        }
[1261](#1261)                    }
[1262](#1262)                    _ => {
[1263](#1263)                        buf.push_str("\\\\");
[1264](#1264)                    }
[1265](#1265)                }
[1266](#1266)            }
[1267](#1267)            '\'' => {
[1268](#1268)                buf.push('\'');
[1269](#1269)            }
[1270](#1270)            '"' => {
[1271](#1271)                buf.push('"');
[1272](#1272)            }
[1273](#1273)            '\x01'..='\x0f' if !first => {
[1274](#1274)                if may_need_quote {
[1275](#1275)                    need_quote = true;
[1276](#1276)                    let _ = write!(buf, "\\x{:x}", c as u8);
[1277](#1277)                } else {
[1278](#1278)                    let _ = write!(buf, "\\u00{:x}", c as u8);
[1279](#1279)                }
[1280](#1280)            }
[1281](#1281)            '\x10'..='\x1f' if !first => {
[1282](#1282)                if may_need_quote {
[1283](#1283)                    need_quote = true;
[1284](#1284)                    let _ = write!(buf, "\\x{:x}", c as u8);
[1285](#1285)                } else {
[1286](#1286)                    let _ = write!(buf, "\\u00{:x}", c as u8);
[1287](#1287)                }
[1288](#1288)            }
[1289](#1289)            '\x20'..='\x7e' => {
[1290](#1290)                buf.push(c);
[1291](#1291)            }
[1292](#1292)            '\u{7f}'..='\u{ff}' => {
[1293](#1293)                if may_need_quote {
[1294](#1294)                    need_quote = true;
[1295](#1295)                    let _ = write!(buf, "\\x{:x}", c as u8);
[1296](#1296)                } else {
[1297](#1297)                    let _ = write!(buf, "\\u00{:x}", c as u8);
[1298](#1298)                }
[1299](#1299)            }
[1300](#1300)            '\u{2028}' => {
[1301](#1301)                buf.push_str("\\u2028");
[1302](#1302)            }
[1303](#1303)            '\u{2029}' => {
[1304](#1304)                buf.push_str("\\u2029");
[1305](#1305)            }
[1306](#1306)            '\u{FEFF}' => {
[1307](#1307)                buf.push_str("\\uFEFF");
[1308](#1308)            }
[1309](#1309)            _ => {
[1310](#1310)                if c.is_ascii() {
[1311](#1311)                    buf.push(c);
[1312](#1312)                } else if c > '\u{FFFF}' {
[1313](#1313)                    if target <= EsVersion::Es5 {
[1319](#1319)                        let h = ((c as u32 - 0x10000) / 0x400) + 0xd800;
[1321](#1321)                        let l = (c as u32 - 0x10000) % 0x400 + 0xdc00;
[1322](#1322)
[1323](#1323)                        let _ = write!(buf, r#""\u{h:04X}\u{l:04X}""#);
[1324](#1324)                    } else {
[1325](#1325)                        let _ = write!(buf, "\\u{{{:04X}}}", c as u32);
[1326](#1326)                    }
[1327](#1327)                } else {
[1328](#1328)                    let _ = write!(buf, "\\u{:04X}", c as u16);
[1329](#1329)                }
[1330](#1330)            }
[1331](#1331)        }
[1332](#1332)        first = false;
[1333](#1333)    }
[1334](#1334)
[1335](#1335)    if need_quote {
[1336](#1336)        CowStr::Owned(format_compact!("\"{}\"", buf))
[1337](#1337)    } else {
[1338](#1338)        CowStr::Owned(buf)
[1339](#1339)    }
[1340](#1340)}
[1341](#1341)
[1342](#1342)fn handle_invalid_unicodes(s: &str) -> Cow<str> {
[1343](#1343)    static NEEDLE: Lazy<Finder> = Lazy::new(|| Finder::new("\\\0"));
[1344](#1344)    if NEEDLE.find(s.as_bytes()).is_none() {
[1345](#1345)        return Cow::Borrowed(s);
[1346](#1346)    }
[1347](#1347)
[1348](#1348)    Cow::Owned(s.replace("\\\0", "\\"))
[1349](#1349)}
[1350](#1350)
[1351](#1351)fn require_space_before_rhs(rhs: &Expr, op: &BinaryOp) -> bool {
[1352](#1352)    match rhs {
[1353](#1353)        Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(v)) if v.value.is_sign_negative() && *op == op!(bin, "-") => true,
[1354](#1354)
[1355](#1355)        Expr::Update(UpdateExpr {
[1356](#1356)            prefix: true,
[1357](#1357)            op: update,
[1358](#1358)            ..
[1359](#1359)        }) => matches!(
[1360](#1360)            (op, update),
[1361](#1361)            (op!(bin, "-"), op!("--")) | (op!(bin, "+"), op!("++"))
[1362](#1362)        ),
[1363](#1363)
[1364](#1364)        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr {
[1366](#1366)            op: op!("!"), arg, ..
[1367](#1367)        }) if *op == op!("<") || *op == op!("<<") => {
[1368](#1368)            if let Expr::Update(UpdateExpr { op: op!("--"), .. }) = &**arg {
[1369](#1369)                true
[1370](#1370)            } else {
[1371](#1371)                false
[1372](#1372)            }
[1373](#1373)        }
[1374](#1374)
[1375](#1375)        Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr { op: unary, .. }) => matches!(
[1376](#1376)            (op, unary),
[1377](#1377)            (op!(bin, "-"), op!(unary, "-")) | (op!(bin, "+"), op!(unary, "+"))
[1378](#1378)        ),
[1379](#1379)
[1380](#1380)        Expr::Bin(BinExpr { left, .. }) => require_space_before_rhs(left, op),
[1381](#1381)
[1382](#1382)        _ => false,
[1383](#1383)    }
[1384](#1384)}
[1385](#1385)
[1386](#1386)fn is_empty_comments(span: &Span, comments: &Option<&dyn Comments>) -> bool {
[1387](#1387)    span.is_dummy() || comments.map_or(true, |c| !c.has_leading(span.span_hi() - BytePos(1)))
[1388](#1388)}
[1389](#1389)
[1390](#1390)fn span_has_leading_comment(cmt: &dyn Comments, span: Span) -> bool {
[1391](#1391)    let lo = span.lo;
[1392](#1392)
[1393](#1393)    if lo.is_dummy() {
[1394](#1394)        return false;
[1395](#1395)    }
[1396](#1396)
[1397](#1397)    if let Some(cmt) = cmt.get_leading(lo) {
[1399](#1399)        if cmt.iter().any(|cmt| {
[1400](#1400)            cmt.kind == CommentKind::Line
[1401](#1401)                || cmt
[1402](#1402)                    .text
[1403](#1403)                    .chars()
[1404](#1404)                    .any(|c| c == '\n' || c == '\r' || c == '\u{2028}' || c == '\u{2029}')
[1406](#1406)        }) {
[1407](#1407)            return true;
[1408](#1408)        }
[1409](#1409)    }
[1410](#1410)
[1411](#1411)    false
[1412](#1412)}

[1431](#1431)impl MacroNode for Module {
[1432](#1432)    #[tracing::instrument(level = "debug", skip_all)]
[1433](#1433)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[1434](#1434)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[1435](#1435)
[1436](#1436)        if self.body.is_empty() {
[1437](#1437)            srcmap!(emitter, self, true);
[1438](#1438)        }
[1439](#1439)
[1440](#1440)        if let Some(ref shebang) = self.shebang {
[1441](#1441)            punct!(emitter, "#!");
[1442](#1442)            emitter.wr.write_str_lit(DUMMY_SP, shebang)?;
[1443](#1443)            emitter.wr.write_line()?;
[1444](#1444)        }
[1445](#1445)        for stmt in &self.body {
[1446](#1446)            emit!(stmt);
[1447](#1447)        }
[1448](#1448)
[1449](#1449)        emitter.emit_trailing_comments_of_pos(self.span().hi, true, true)?;
[1450](#1450)        if !emitter.cfg.omit_last_semi {
[1451](#1451)            emitter.wr.commit_pending_semi()?;
[1452](#1452)        }
[1453](#1453)
[1454](#1454)        Ok(())
[1455](#1455)    }

[1610](#1610)#[node_impl]
[1611](#1611)impl MacroNode for OptChainExpr {
[1612](#1612)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[1613](#1613)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[1614](#1614)
[1615](#1615)        match &*self.base {
[1616](#1616)            OptChainBase::Member(e) => {
[1617](#1617)                if let Expr::New(new) = &*e.obj {
[1618](#1618)                    emitter.emit_new(new, false)?;
[1619](#1619)                } else {
[1620](#1620)                    emit!(e.obj);
[1621](#1621)                }
[1622](#1622)                if self.optional {
[1623](#1623)                    punct!(emitter, "?.");
[1624](#1624)                } else if !e.prop.is_computed() {
[1625](#1625)                    punct!(emitter, ".");
[1626](#1626)                }
[1627](#1627)
[1628](#1628)                match &e.prop {
[1629](#1629)                    MemberProp::Computed(computed) => emit!(computed),
[1630](#1630)                    MemberProp::Ident(i) => emit!(i),
[1631](#1631)                    MemberProp::PrivateName(p) => emit!(p),
[1632](#1632)                    #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[1633](#1633)                    _ => return Err(unknown_error()),
[1634](#1634)                }
[1635](#1635)            }
[1636](#1636)            OptChainBase::Call(e) => {
[1637](#1637)                debug_assert!(!e.callee.is_new());
[1638](#1638)                emit!(e.callee);
[1639](#1639)
[1640](#1640)                if self.optional {
[1641](#1641)                    punct!(emitter, "?.");
[1642](#1642)                }
[1643](#1643)
[1644](#1644)                punct!(emitter, "(");
[1645](#1645)                emitter.emit_expr_or_spreads(
[1646](#1646)                    self.span(),
[1647](#1647)                    &e.args,
[1648](#1648)                    ListFormat::CallExpressionArguments,
[1649](#1649)                )?;

[1710](#1710)impl MacroNode for MemberExpr {
[1711](#1711)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[1712](#1712)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[1713](#1713)
[1714](#1714)        srcmap!(emitter, self, true);
[1715](#1715)
[1716](#1716)        let mut needs_2dots_for_property_access = false;
[1717](#1717)
[1718](#1718)        match &*self.obj {
[1719](#1719)            Expr::New(new) => {
[1720](#1720)                emitter.emit_new(new, false)?;
[1721](#1721)            }
[1722](#1722)            Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(num)) => {
[1723](#1723)                needs_2dots_for_property_access = emitter.emit_num_lit_internal(num, true)?;
[1724](#1724)            }
[1725](#1725)            _ => {
[1726](#1726)                emit!(self.obj);
[1727](#1727)            }
[1728](#1728)        }
[1729](#1729)
[1730](#1730)        match &self.prop {
[1731](#1731)            MemberProp::Computed(computed) => emit!(computed),
[1732](#1732)            MemberProp::Ident(ident) => {
[1733](#1733)                if needs_2dots_for_property_access {
[1734](#1734)                    if self.prop.span().lo() >= BytePos(2) {
[1735](#1735)                        emitter.emit_leading_comments(self.prop.span().lo() - BytePos(2), false)?;
[1736](#1736)                    }
[1737](#1737)                    punct!(emitter, ".");
[1738](#1738)                }
[1739](#1739)                if self.prop.span().lo() >= BytePos(1) {
[1740](#1740)                    emitter.emit_leading_comments(self.prop.span().lo() - BytePos(1), false)?;
[1741](#1741)                }
[1742](#1742)                punct!(emitter, ".");
[1743](#1743)                emit!(ident);
[1744](#1744)            }
[1745](#1745)            MemberProp::PrivateName(private) => {
[1746](#1746)                if needs_2dots_for_property_access {
[1747](#1747)                    if self.prop.span().lo() >= BytePos(2) {
[1748](#1748)                        emitter.emit_leading_comments(self.prop.span().lo() - BytePos(2), false)?;
[1749](#1749)                    }
[1750](#1750)                    punct!(emitter, ".");
[1751](#1751)                }
[1752](#1752)                if self.prop.span().lo() >= BytePos(1) {
[1753](#1753)                    emitter.emit_leading_comments(self.prop.span().lo() - BytePos(1), false)?;
[1754](#1754)                }
[1755](#1755)                punct!(emitter, ".");
[1756](#1756)                emit!(private);
[1757](#1757)            }
[1758](#1758)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[1759](#1759)            _ => return Err(unknown_error()),
[1760](#1760)        }
[1761](#1761)
[1762](#1762)        srcmap!(emitter, self, false);
[1763](#1763)
[1764](#1764)        Ok(())
[1765](#1765)    }

[1795](#1795)impl MacroNode for ArrowExpr {
[1796](#1796)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[1797](#1797)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[1798](#1798)
[1799](#1799)        srcmap!(emitter, self, true);
[1800](#1800)
[1801](#1801)        let space = !emitter.cfg.minify
[1802](#1802)            || match self.params.as_slice() {
[1803](#1803)                [Pat::Ident(_)] => true,
[1804](#1804)                _ => false,
[1805](#1805)            };
[1806](#1806)
[1807](#1807)        if self.is_async {
[1808](#1808)            keyword!(emitter, "async");
[1809](#1809)            if space {
[1810](#1810)                space!(emitter);
[1811](#1811)            } else {
[1812](#1812)                formatting_space!(emitter);
[1813](#1813)            }
[1814](#1814)        }
[1815](#1815)        if self.is_generator {
[1816](#1816)            punct!(emitter, "*")
[1817](#1817)        }
[1818](#1818)
[1819](#1819)        let parens = !emitter.cfg.minify
[1820](#1820)            || match self.params.as_slice() {
[1821](#1821)                [Pat::Ident(i)] => emitter.has_trailing_comment(i.span),
[1822](#1822)                _ => true,
[1823](#1823)            };
[1824](#1824)
[1825](#1825)        emit!(self.type_params);
[1826](#1826)
[1827](#1827)        if parens {
[1828](#1828)            punct!(emitter, "(");
[1829](#1829)        }
[1830](#1830)
[1831](#1831)        emitter.emit_list(self.span, Some(&self.params), ListFormat::CommaListElements)?;
[1832](#1832)        if parens {
[1833](#1833)            punct!(emitter, ")");
[1834](#1834)        }
[1835](#1835)
[1836](#1836)        if let Some(ty) = &self.return_type {
[1837](#1837)            punct!(emitter, ":");
[1838](#1838)            formatting_space!(emitter);
[1839](#1839)            emit!(ty);
[1840](#1840)            formatting_space!(emitter);
[1841](#1841)        }
[1842](#1842)
[1843](#1843)        punct!(emitter, "=>");
[1844](#1844)        emit!(self.body);
[1845](#1845)
[1846](#1846)        Ok(())
[1847](#1847)    }

[1911](#1911)#[node_impl]
[1912](#1912)impl MacroNode for BinExpr {
[1913](#1913)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[1914](#1914)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[1915](#1915)
[1916](#1916)        srcmap!(emitter, self, true);
[1917](#1917)
[1918](#1918)        {
[1919](#1919)            let mut left = Some(self);
[1920](#1920)            let mut lefts = Vec::new();
[1921](#1921)            while let Some(l) = left {
[1922](#1922)                lefts.push(l);
[1923](#1923)
[1924](#1924)                match &*l.left {
[1925](#1925)                    Expr::Bin(b) => {
[1926](#1926)                        left = Some(b);
[1927](#1927)                    }
[1928](#1928)                    _ => break,
[1929](#1929)                }
[1930](#1930)            }
[1931](#1931)
[1932](#1932)            let len = lefts.len();
[1933](#1933)
[1934](#1934)            for (i, left) in lefts.into_iter().rev().enumerate() {
[1935](#1935)                if i == 0 {
[1936](#1936)                    emit!(left.left);
[1937](#1937)                }
[1938](#1938)                if i + 1 != len {
[1940](#1940)                    emitter.emit_bin_expr_trailing(left)?;
[1941](#1941)                }
[1942](#1942)            }
[1943](#1943)        }
[1944](#1944)
[1945](#1945)        emitter.emit_bin_expr_trailing(self)?;
[1946](#1946)
[1947](#1947)        Ok(())
[1948](#1948)    }

[2052](#2052)impl MacroNode for Tpl {
[2053](#2053)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[2054](#2054)        debug_assert!(self.quasis.len() == self.exprs.len() + 1);
[2055](#2055)
[2056](#2056)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[2057](#2057)
[2058](#2058)        srcmap!(emitter, self, true);
[2059](#2059)
[2060](#2060)        punct!(emitter, "`");
[2061](#2061)
[2062](#2062)        for i in 0..(self.quasis.len() + self.exprs.len()) {
[2063](#2063)            if i % 2 == 0 {
[2064](#2064)                emit!(self.quasis[i / 2]);
[2065](#2065)            } else {
[2066](#2066)                punct!(emitter, "${");
[2067](#2067)                emit!(self.exprs[i / 2]);
[2068](#2068)                punct!(emitter, "}");
[2069](#2069)            }
[2070](#2070)        }
[2071](#2071)
[2072](#2072)        punct!(emitter, "`");
[2073](#2073)
[2074](#2074)        srcmap!(emitter, self, false);
[2075](#2075)
[2076](#2076)        Ok(())
[2077](#2077)    }

[2080](#2080)#[node_impl]
[2081](#2081)impl MacroNode for TplElement {
[2082](#2082)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[2083](#2083)        let raw = self.raw.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace('\r', "\n");
[2084](#2084)        if emitter.cfg.minify || (emitter.cfg.ascii_only && !self.raw.is_ascii()) {
[2085](#2085)            let v = get_template_element_from_raw(
[2086](#2086)                &raw,
[2087](#2087)                emitter.cfg.ascii_only,
[2088](#2088)                emitter.cfg.reduce_escaped_newline,
[2089](#2089)            );
[2090](#2090)            let span = self.span();
[2091](#2091)
[2092](#2092)            let mut last_offset_gen = 0;
[2093](#2093)            let mut last_offset_origin = 0;
[2094](#2094)            for ((offset_gen, _), mat) in v
[2095](#2095)                .match_indices('\n')
[2096](#2096)                .zip(NEW_LINE_TPL_REGEX.find_iter(&raw))
[2097](#2097)            {
[2098](#2098)                if offset_gen != 0 {
[2101](#2101)                    emitter
[2102](#2102)                        .wr
[2103](#2103)                        .add_srcmap(span.lo + BytePos(last_offset_origin as u32))?;
[2104](#2104)                }
[2105](#2105)
[2106](#2106)                emitter
[2107](#2107)                    .wr
[2108](#2108)                    .write_str_lit(DUMMY_SP, &v[last_offset_gen..=offset_gen])?;
[2109](#2109)                last_offset_gen = offset_gen + 1;
[2110](#2110)                last_offset_origin = mat.end();
[2111](#2111)            }
[2112](#2112)            emitter
[2113](#2113)                .wr
[2114](#2114)                .add_srcmap(span.lo + BytePos(last_offset_origin as u32))?;
[2115](#2115)            emitter.wr.write_str_lit(DUMMY_SP, &v[last_offset_gen..])?;
[2116](#2116)            emitter.wr.add_srcmap(span.hi)?;
[2117](#2117)        } else {
[2118](#2118)            emitter.wr.write_str_lit(self.span(), &raw)?;
[2119](#2119)        }
[2120](#2120)
[2121](#2121)        Ok(())
[2122](#2122)    }
[2123](#2123)}

[2147](#2147)#[node_impl]
[2148](#2148)impl MacroNode for UnaryExpr {
[2149](#2149)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[2150](#2150)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[2151](#2151)
[2152](#2152)        srcmap!(emitter, self, true);
[2153](#2153)
[2154](#2154)        let need_formatting_space = match self.op {
[2155](#2155)            op!("typeof") | op!("void") | op!("delete") => {
[2156](#2156)                keyword!(emitter, self.op.as_str());
[2157](#2157)
[2158](#2158)                true
[2159](#2159)            }
[2160](#2160)            op!(unary, "+") | op!(unary, "-") | op!("!") | op!("~") => {
[2161](#2161)                punct!(emitter, self.op.as_str());
[2162](#2162)                false
[2163](#2163)            }
[2164](#2164)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[2165](#2165)            _ => return Err(unknown_error()),
[2166](#2166)        };
[2167](#2167)
[2168](#2168)        if should_emit_whitespace_before_operand(self) {
[2169](#2169)            space!(emitter);
[2170](#2170)        } else if need_formatting_space {
[2171](#2171)            formatting_space!(emitter);
[2172](#2172)        }
[2173](#2173)
[2174](#2174)        emit!(self.arg);
[2175](#2175)
[2176](#2176)        Ok(())
[2177](#2177)    }
[2178](#2178)}

## This struct is marked as non-exhaustive

`Struct { .. }` syntax; cannot be matched against without a wildcard `..`; and struct update syntax will not work.[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#structfield.target)

`target: EsVersion`The target runtime environment.

This defaults to [EsVersion::latest] because it preserves input as much as possible.

Note: This does not verifies if output is valid for the target runtime.
e.g. `const foo = 1;` with [EsVersion::Es3] will emitted as `const foo = 1` without verification.
This is because it’s not a concern of the code generator.

[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#structfield.ascii_only)

`ascii_only: `[bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html)Forces the code generator to use only ascii characters.

This is useful for environments that do not support unicode.

[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#structfield.minify)

`minify: `[bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html)[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#structfield.omit_last_semi)

`omit_last_semi: `[bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html)If true, the code generator will emit the lastest semicolon.

Defaults to `false`.

[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#structfield.emit_assert_for_import_attributes)

`emit_assert_for_import_attributes: `[bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html)[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#structfield.inline_script)

`inline_script: `[bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html)[§](https://rustdoc.swc.rs#structfield.reduce_escaped_newline)

`reduce_escaped_newline: `[bool](https://doc.rust-lang.org/nightly/std/primitive.bool.html)Transform escaped newline `'\n'` of `TplElement` to a newline character
to reduce text size of javascript code

Defaults to `true`

[119](#119)        let hi = $n.span_hi();
[120](#120)        if !hi.is_dummy() {
[121](#121)            if $subtract {
[122](#122)                $emitter.wr.add_srcmap(hi - swc_common::BytePos(1))?;
[124](#124)            } else {
[125](#125)                $emitter.wr.add_srcmap(hi)?;
[127](#127)            }
[128](#128)        }

[3](#3)pub trait EndsWithAlphaNum {
[4](#4)    fn ends_with_alpha_num(&self) -> bool;
[5](#5)}
[6](#6)
[7](#7)impl EndsWithAlphaNum for ForHead {
[8](#8)    fn ends_with_alpha_num(&self) -> bool {
[9](#9)        match self {
[10](#10)            ForHead::VarDecl(n) => n.ends_with_alpha_num(),
[11](#11)            ForHead::Pat(n) => n.ends_with_alpha_num(),
[12](#12)            ForHead::UsingDecl(n) => n.ends_with_alpha_num(),
[13](#13)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[14](#14)            _ => false,
[15](#15)        }
[16](#16)    }
[17](#17)}
[18](#18)
[19](#19)impl EndsWithAlphaNum for Pat {
[20](#20)    fn ends_with_alpha_num(&self) -> bool {
[21](#21)        match self {
[22](#22)            Pat::Object(_) | Pat::Array(_) => false,
[23](#23)            Pat::Rest(p) => p.arg.ends_with_alpha_num(),
[24](#24)            Pat::Assign(p) => p.right.ends_with_alpha_num(),
[25](#25)            Pat::Expr(p) => p.ends_with_alpha_num(),
[26](#26)            _ => true,
[27](#27)        }
[28](#28)    }
[29](#29)}
[30](#30)
[31](#31)impl EndsWithAlphaNum for VarDecl {
[32](#32)    fn ends_with_alpha_num(&self) -> bool {
[33](#33)        match self.decls.last() {
[34](#34)            None => true,
[35](#35)            Some(d) => match d.init.as_deref() {
[36](#36)                Some(e) => e.ends_with_alpha_num(),
[37](#37)                None => d.name.ends_with_alpha_num(),
[38](#38)            },
[39](#39)        }
[40](#40)    }
[41](#41)}
[42](#42)
[43](#43)impl EndsWithAlphaNum for UsingDecl {
[44](#44)    fn ends_with_alpha_num(&self) -> bool {
[45](#45)        match self.decls.last() {
[46](#46)            None => true,
[47](#47)            Some(d) => match d.init.as_deref() {
[48](#48)                Some(e) => e.ends_with_alpha_num(),
[49](#49)                None => d.name.ends_with_alpha_num(),
[50](#50)            },
[51](#51)        }
[52](#52)    }
[53](#53)}
[54](#54)
[55](#55)impl EndsWithAlphaNum for Expr {
[56](#56)    fn ends_with_alpha_num(&self) -> bool {
[57](#57)        match self {
[58](#58)            Expr::Array(..)
[59](#59)            | Expr::Object(..)
[60](#60)            | Expr::Lit(Lit::Str(..))
[61](#61)            | Expr::Paren(..)
[62](#62)            | Expr::Member(MemberExpr {
[63](#63)                prop: MemberProp::Computed(..),
[64](#64)                ..
[65](#65)            })
[66](#66)            | Expr::Tpl(..)
[67](#67)            | Expr::TaggedTpl(..)
[68](#68)            | Expr::Call(..) => false,
[69](#69)
[70](#70)            Expr::Unary(n) => n.arg.ends_with_alpha_num(),
[71](#71)
[72](#72)            Expr::Update(n) => n.prefix && n.arg.ends_with_alpha_num(),
[73](#73)
[74](#74)            Expr::OptChain(n) => match n.base.as_ref() {
[75](#75)                OptChainBase::Member(base) => !base.prop.is_computed(),
[76](#76)                OptChainBase::Call(_) => false,
[77](#77)                #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[78](#78)                _ => false,
[79](#79)            },
[80](#80)
[81](#81)            Expr::Bin(n) => n.right.ends_with_alpha_num(),
[82](#82)
[83](#83)            Expr::New(NewExpr {
[84](#84)                args: Some(args), ..
[85](#85)            }) => args.is_empty(),
[86](#86)
[87](#87)            _ => true,
[88](#88)        }
[89](#89)    }
[90](#90)}

[101](#101)            fn starts_with_alpha_num(&self) -> bool {
[102](#102)                match *self {
[103](#103)                    $(
[104](#104)                        Self::$name(ref n) => n.starts_with_alpha_num(),
[105](#105)                    )*
[106](#106)                    #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]

[108](#108)                }
[109](#109)            }

[167](#167)    fn starts_with_alpha_num(&self) -> bool {
[168](#168)        match self {
[169](#169)            PropName::Str(_) | PropName::Computed(_) => false,
[170](#170)            PropName::Ident(_) | PropName::Num(_) | PropName::BigInt(_) => true,
[171](#171)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[172](#172)            _ => false,
[173](#173)        }
[174](#174)    }
[175](#175)}
[176](#176)
[177](#177)impl StartsWithAlphaNum for Expr {
[178](#178)    fn starts_with_alpha_num(&self) -> bool {
[179](#179)        match self {
[180](#180)            Expr::Ident(_)
[181](#181)            | Expr::Lit(Lit::Bool(_))
[182](#182)            | Expr::Lit(Lit::Num(_))
[183](#183)            | Expr::Lit(Lit::Null(_))
[184](#184)            | Expr::Lit(Lit::BigInt(_))
[185](#185)            | Expr::Await(_)
[186](#186)            | Expr::Fn(_)
[187](#187)            | Expr::Class(_)
[188](#188)            | Expr::This(_)
[189](#189)            | Expr::Yield(_)
[190](#190)            | Expr::New(_)
[191](#191)            | Expr::MetaProp(_)
[192](#192)            | Expr::SuperProp(_) => true,
[193](#193)
[194](#194)            Expr::PrivateName(_) => false,
[195](#195)
[196](#196)            Expr::Lit(_) => false,
[198](#198)
[199](#199)            Expr::Seq(SeqExpr { ref exprs, .. }) => exprs
[200](#200)                .first()
[201](#201)                .map(|e| e.starts_with_alpha_num())
[202](#202)                .unwrap_or(false),
[203](#203)
[204](#204)            Expr::Assign(AssignExpr { ref left, .. }) => left.starts_with_alpha_num(),
[206](#206)
[207](#207)            Expr::Bin(BinExpr { ref left, .. }) | Expr::Cond(CondExpr { test: ref left, .. }) => {
[208](#208)                left.starts_with_alpha_num()
[209](#209)            }
[210](#210)            Expr::Call(CallExpr { callee: left, .. }) => left.starts_with_alpha_num(),
[211](#211)            Expr::Member(MemberExpr { obj: ref left, .. }) => left.starts_with_alpha_num(),
[212](#212)
[213](#213)            Expr::Unary(UnaryExpr { op, .. }) => {
[214](#214)                matches!(op, op!("void") | op!("delete") | op!("typeof"))
[215](#215)            }
[216](#216)
[217](#217)            Expr::Arrow(ref expr) => {
[218](#218)                if expr.is_async {
[219](#219)                    true
[220](#220)                } else {
[221](#221)                    match expr.params.as_slice() {
[222](#222)                        [p] => p.starts_with_alpha_num(),
[223](#223)                        _ => false,
[224](#224)                    }
[225](#225)                }
[226](#226)            }
[227](#227)
[228](#228)            Expr::Update(ref expr) => {
[229](#229)                if expr.prefix {
[230](#230)                    false
[231](#231)                } else {
[232](#232)                    expr.arg.starts_with_alpha_num()
[233](#233)                }
[234](#234)            }
[235](#235)
[236](#236)            Expr::Tpl(_) | Expr::Array(_) | Expr::Object(_) | Expr::Paren(_) => false,
[237](#237)
[238](#238)            Expr::TaggedTpl(TaggedTpl { ref tag, .. }) => tag.starts_with_alpha_num(),
[239](#239)
[240](#240)            Expr::JSXEmpty(..) => false,
[242](#242)            Expr::JSXFragment(..) | Expr::JSXElement(..) => false,
[244](#244)            Expr::JSXNamespacedName(..) => true,
[245](#245)            Expr::JSXMember(..) => true,
[246](#246)
[247](#247)            Expr::TsTypeAssertion(..) => false,
[248](#248)            Expr::TsNonNull(TsNonNullExpr { ref expr, .. })
[249](#249)            | Expr::TsAs(TsAsExpr { ref expr, .. })
[250](#250)            | Expr::TsConstAssertion(TsConstAssertion { ref expr, .. })
[251](#251)            | Expr::TsInstantiation(TsInstantiation { ref expr, .. })
[252](#252)            | Expr::TsSatisfies(TsSatisfiesExpr { ref expr, .. }) => expr.starts_with_alpha_num(),
[253](#253)
[254](#254)            Expr::OptChain(e) => e.starts_with_alpha_num(),
[255](#255)
[256](#256)            Expr::Invalid(..) => true,
[257](#257)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[258](#258)            _ => false,
[259](#259)        }
[260](#260)    }
[261](#261)}
[262](#262)
[263](#263)impl StartsWithAlphaNum for OptChainExpr {
[264](#264)    fn starts_with_alpha_num(&self) -> bool {
[265](#265)        match &*self.base {
[266](#266)            OptChainBase::Member(base) => base.obj.starts_with_alpha_num(),
[267](#267)            OptChainBase::Call(base) => base.callee.starts_with_alpha_num(),
[268](#268)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[269](#269)            _ => false,
[270](#270)        }
[271](#271)    }
[272](#272)}

[279](#279)            Pat::Object(..) | Pat::Array(..) | Pat::Rest(..) => false,
[280](#280)            Pat::Expr(ref expr) => expr.starts_with_alpha_num(),

[334](#334)            Stmt::Decl(ref decl) => decl.starts_with_alpha_num(),
[335](#335)            Stmt::Debugger(..)
[336](#336)            | Stmt::With(..)
[337](#337)            | Stmt::While(..)
[338](#338)            | Stmt::DoWhile(..)
[339](#339)            | Stmt::Return(..)
[340](#340)            | Stmt::Labeled(..)
[341](#341)            | Stmt::Break(..)

[343](#343)            | Stmt::Switch(..)

[345](#345)            | Stmt::Try(..)
[346](#346)            | Stmt::For(..)
[347](#347)            | Stmt::ForIn(..)
[348](#348)            | Stmt::ForOf(..)
[349](#349)            | Stmt::If(..) => true,
[350](#350)            Stmt::Block(..) | Stmt::Empty(..) => false,
[351](#351)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[352](#352)            _ => false,
[353](#353)        }
[354](#354)    }

[16](#16)    pub fn emit_class_trailing(&mut self, node: &Class) -> Result {
[17](#17)        if node.super_class.is_some() {
[18](#18)            space!(self);
[19](#19)            keyword!(self, "extends");
[20](#20)
[21](#21)            {
[22](#22)                let starts_with_alpha_num =
[23](#23)                    node.super_class.as_ref().unwrap().starts_with_alpha_num();
[24](#24)
[25](#25)                if starts_with_alpha_num {
[26](#26)                    space!(self);
[27](#27)                } else {
[28](#28)                    formatting_space!(self)
[29](#29)                }
[30](#30)            }
[31](#31)            emit!(self, node.super_class);
[32](#32)            emit!(self, node.super_type_params);
[33](#33)        }
[34](#34)
[35](#35)        if !node.implements.is_empty() {
[36](#36)            space!(self);
[37](#37)            keyword!(self, "implements");
[38](#38)
[39](#39)            space!(self);
[40](#40)

[42](#42)                node.span,
[43](#43)                Some(&node.implements),
[44](#44)                ListFormat::ClassHeritageClauses,
[45](#45)            )?;
[46](#46)        }
[47](#47)
[48](#48)        formatting_space!(self);
[49](#49)
[50](#50)        punct!(self, "{");
[51](#51)
[52](#52)        self.emit_list(node.span, Some(&node.body), ListFormat::ClassMembers)?;
[53](#53)
[54](#54)        srcmap!(self, node, false, true);
[55](#55)        punct!(self, "}");
[56](#56)
[57](#57)        Ok(())
[58](#58)    }

[139](#139)impl MacroNode for ClassMember {
[140](#140)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[141](#141)        match self {
[142](#142)            ClassMember::Constructor(ref n) => emit!(n),
[143](#143)            ClassMember::ClassProp(ref n) => emit!(n),
[144](#144)            ClassMember::Method(ref n) => emit!(n),
[145](#145)            ClassMember::PrivateMethod(ref n) => emit!(n),
[146](#146)            ClassMember::PrivateProp(ref n) => emit!(n),
[147](#147)            ClassMember::TsIndexSignature(ref n) => emit!(n),
[148](#148)            ClassMember::Empty(ref n) => emit!(n),
[149](#149)            ClassMember::StaticBlock(ref n) => emit!(n),
[150](#150)            ClassMember::AutoAccessor(ref n) => emit!(n),
[151](#151)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[152](#152)            _ => return Err(unknown_error()),
[153](#153)        }
[154](#154)
[155](#155)        Ok(())
[156](#156)    }

[160](#160)impl MacroNode for AutoAccessor {
[161](#161)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[162](#162)        emitter.emit_list(self.span, Some(&self.decorators), ListFormat::Decorators)?;
[163](#163)
[164](#164)        emitter.emit_accessibility(self.accessibility)?;
[165](#165)
[166](#166)        if self.is_static {
[167](#167)            keyword!(emitter, "static");
[168](#168)            space!(emitter);
[169](#169)        }
[170](#170)
[171](#171)        if self.is_abstract {
[172](#172)            keyword!(emitter, "abstract");
[173](#173)            space!(emitter);
[174](#174)        }
[175](#175)
[176](#176)        if self.is_override {
[177](#177)            keyword!(emitter, "override");
[178](#178)            space!(emitter);
[179](#179)        }
[180](#180)
[181](#181)        keyword!(emitter, "accessor");
[182](#182)        space!(emitter);
[183](#183)
[184](#184)        emit!(self.key);
[185](#185)
[186](#186)        if let Some(type_ann) = &self.type_ann {
[187](#187)            if self.definite {
[188](#188)                punct!(emitter, "!");
[189](#189)            }
[190](#190)            punct!(emitter, ":");
[191](#191)            space!(emitter);
[192](#192)            emit!(type_ann);
[193](#193)        }
[194](#194)
[195](#195)        if let Some(init) = &self.value {
[196](#196)            formatting_space!(emitter);
[197](#197)            punct!(emitter, "=");
[198](#198)            formatting_space!(emitter);
[199](#199)            emit!(init);
[200](#200)        }
[201](#201)
[202](#202)        semi!(emitter);
[203](#203)
[204](#204)        Ok(())
[205](#205)    }

[232](#232)        }
[233](#233)        match self.kind {
[234](#234)            MethodKind::Method => {

[239](#239)                if self.function.is_generator {
[240](#240)                    punct!(emitter, "*");

[244](#244)            }
[245](#245)            MethodKind::Getter => {
[246](#246)                keyword!(emitter, "get");
[247](#247)                space!(emitter);
[248](#248)
[249](#249)                emit!(self.key);
[250](#250)            }
[251](#251)            MethodKind::Setter => {
[252](#252)                keyword!(emitter, "set");
[253](#253)                space!(emitter);
[254](#254)
[255](#255)                emit!(self.key);
[256](#256)            }
[257](#257)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]

[268](#268)impl MacroNode for ClassMethod {
[269](#269)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[270](#270)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[271](#271)
[272](#272)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.key.span(), false)?;
