[274](#274)        srcmap!(emitter, self, true);
[275](#275)
[276](#276)        for d in &self.function.decorators {
[277](#277)            emit!(d);
[278](#278)        }
[279](#279)
[280](#280)        emitter.emit_accessibility(self.accessibility)?;
[281](#281)
[282](#282)        if self.is_static {
[283](#283)            keyword!(emitter, "static");
[284](#284)
[285](#285)            let starts_with_alpha_num = match self.kind {
[286](#286)                MethodKind::Method => {
[287](#287)                    if self.function.is_async {
[288](#288)                        true
[289](#289)                    } else if self.function.is_generator {
[290](#290)                        false
[291](#291)                    } else {
[292](#292)                        self.key.starts_with_alpha_num()
[293](#293)                    }
[294](#294)                }
[295](#295)                MethodKind::Getter => true,
[296](#296)                MethodKind::Setter => true,
[297](#297)                #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[298](#298)                _ => return Err(unknown_error()),
[299](#299)            };
[300](#300)
[301](#301)            if starts_with_alpha_num {
[302](#302)                space!(emitter);
[303](#303)            } else {
[304](#304)                formatting_space!(emitter);
[305](#305)            }
[306](#306)        }
[307](#307)
[308](#308)        if self.is_abstract {
[309](#309)            keyword!(emitter, "abstract");
[310](#310)            space!(emitter)
[311](#311)        }
[312](#312)
[313](#313)        if self.is_override {
[314](#314)            keyword!(emitter, "override");
[315](#315)            space!(emitter)
[316](#316)        }
[317](#317)
[318](#318)        match self.kind {
[319](#319)            MethodKind::Method => {
[320](#320)                if self.function.is_async {
[321](#321)                    keyword!(emitter, "async");
[322](#322)                    space!(emitter);
[323](#323)                }
[324](#324)                if self.function.is_generator {
[325](#325)                    punct!(emitter, "*");
[326](#326)                }
[327](#327)
[328](#328)                emit!(self.key);
[329](#329)            }
[330](#330)            MethodKind::Getter => {
[331](#331)                keyword!(emitter, "get");
[332](#332)
[333](#333)                if self.key.starts_with_alpha_num() {
[334](#334)                    space!(emitter);
[335](#335)                } else {
[336](#336)                    formatting_space!(emitter)
[337](#337)                }
[338](#338)
[339](#339)                emit!(self.key);
[340](#340)            }
[341](#341)            MethodKind::Setter => {
[342](#342)                keyword!(emitter, "set");
[343](#343)
[344](#344)                if self.key.starts_with_alpha_num() {
[345](#345)                    space!(emitter);
[346](#346)                } else {
[347](#347)                    formatting_space!(emitter)
[348](#348)                }
[349](#349)
[350](#350)                emit!(self.key);
[351](#351)            }
[352](#352)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[353](#353)            _ => return Err(unknown_error()),
[354](#354)        }
[355](#355)
[356](#356)        if self.is_optional {
[357](#357)            punct!(emitter, "?");
[358](#358)        }
[359](#359)
[360](#360)        if let Some(type_params) = &self.function.type_params {
[361](#361)            emit!(type_params);
[362](#362)        }
[363](#363)
[364](#364)        punct!(emitter, "(");
[365](#365)        emitter.emit_list(
[366](#366)            self.function.span,
[367](#367)            Some(&self.function.params),
[368](#368)            ListFormat::CommaListElements,
[369](#369)        )?;
[370](#370)
[371](#371)        punct!(emitter, ")");
[372](#372)
[373](#373)        if let Some(ty) = &self.function.return_type {
[374](#374)            punct!(emitter, ":");
[375](#375)            formatting_space!(emitter);
[376](#376)            emit!(ty);
[377](#377)        }
[378](#378)
[379](#379)        if let Some(body) = &self.function.body {
[380](#380)            formatting_space!(emitter);
[381](#381)            emit!(body);
[382](#382)        } else {
[383](#383)            formatting_semi!(emitter)
[384](#384)        }
[385](#385)
[386](#386)        Ok(())
[387](#387)    }

[566](#566)
[567](#567)impl<W, S: SourceMapper> Emitter<'_, W, S>
[568](#568)where
[569](#569)    W: WriteJs,
[570](#570)    S: SourceMapperExt,
[571](#571){
[572](#572)    pub fn emit_accessibility(&mut self, n: Option<Accessibility>) -> Result {
[573](#573)        if let Some(a) = n {
[574](#574)            match a {
[575](#575)                Accessibility::Public => keyword!(self, "public"),
[576](#576)                Accessibility::Protected => keyword!(self, "protected"),
[577](#577)                Accessibility::Private => keyword!(self, "private"),
[578](#578)                #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[579](#579)                _ => return Err(unknown_error()),
[580](#580)            }
[581](#581)            space!(self);
[582](#582)        }
[583](#583)
[584](#584)        Ok(())
[585](#585)    }

# lit.rs - source

[13](#13)
[14](#14)#[node_impl]
[15](#15)impl MacroNode for Lit {
[16](#16)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[17](#17)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[18](#18)
[19](#19)        srcmap!(emitter, self, true);
[20](#20)
[21](#21)        match self {
[22](#22)            Lit::Bool(Bool { value, .. }) => {
[23](#23)                if *value {
[24](#24)                    keyword!(emitter, "true")
[25](#25)                } else {
[26](#26)                    keyword!(emitter, "false")
[27](#27)                }
[28](#28)            }
[29](#29)            Lit::Null(Null { .. }) => keyword!(emitter, "null"),
[30](#30)            Lit::Str(ref s) => emit!(s),
[31](#31)            Lit::BigInt(ref s) => emit!(s),
[32](#32)            Lit::Num(ref n) => emit!(n),
[33](#33)            Lit::Regex(ref n) => {
[34](#34)                punct!(emitter, "/");
[35](#35)                let encoded_exp = encode_regex_for_ascii(&n.exp, emitter.cfg.ascii_only);
[37](#37)                emitter.wr.write_str(&encoded_exp)?;
[38](#38)                punct!(emitter, "/");
[39](#39)                emitter.wr.write_str(&n.flags)?;
[40](#40)            }
[41](#41)            Lit::JSXText(ref n) => emit!(n),
[42](#42)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[43](#43)            _ => return Err(unknown_error()),
[44](#44)        }
[45](#45)
[46](#46)        Ok(())
[47](#47)    }
[48](#48)}
[49](#49)
[50](#50)#[node_impl]
[51](#51)impl MacroNode for Str {
[52](#52)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[53](#53)        emitter.wr.commit_pending_semi()?;
[54](#54)
[55](#55)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[56](#56)
[57](#57)        srcmap!(emitter, self, true);
[58](#58)
[59](#59)        if &*self.value == "use strict"
[60](#60)            && self.raw.is_some()
[61](#61)            && self.raw.as_ref().unwrap().contains('\\')
[62](#62)            && (!emitter.cfg.inline_script || !self.raw.as_ref().unwrap().contains("script"))
[63](#63)        {
[64](#64)            emitter
[65](#65)                .wr
[66](#66)                .write_str_lit(DUMMY_SP, self.raw.as_ref().unwrap())?;
[67](#67)
[68](#68)            srcmap!(emitter, self, false);
[69](#69)
[70](#70)            return Ok(());
[71](#71)        }
[72](#72)
[73](#73)        let target = emitter.cfg.target;
[74](#74)
[75](#75)        if !emitter.cfg.minify {
[76](#76)            if let Some(raw) = &self.raw {
[77](#77)                let es5_safe = match emitter.cfg.target {
[78](#78)                    EsVersion::Es3 | EsVersion::Es5 => {
[79](#79)                        !raw.contains("\\u{")
[82](#82)                    }
[83](#83)                    _ => true,
[84](#84)                };
[85](#85)
[86](#86)                if es5_safe
[87](#87)                    && (!emitter.cfg.ascii_only || raw.is_ascii())
[88](#88)                    && (!emitter.cfg.inline_script
[89](#89)                        || !self.raw.as_ref().unwrap().contains("script"))
[90](#90)                {
[91](#91)                    emitter.wr.write_str_lit(DUMMY_SP, raw)?;
[92](#92)                    return Ok(());
[93](#93)                }
[94](#94)            }
[95](#95)        }
[96](#96)
[97](#97)        let (quote_char, mut value) = get_quoted_utf16(&self.value, emitter.cfg.ascii_only, target);
[98](#98)
[99](#99)        if emitter.cfg.inline_script {
[100](#100)            value = CowStr::Owned(
[101](#101)                replace_close_inline_script(&value)
[102](#102)                    .replace("\x3c!--", "\\x3c!--")
[103](#103)                    .replace("--\x3e", "--\\x3e")
[104](#104)                    .into(),
[105](#105)            );
[106](#106)        }
[107](#107)
[108](#108)        let quote_str = [quote_char.as_byte()];
[109](#109)        let quote_str = unsafe {
[110](#110)            str::from_utf8_unchecked("e_str)
[112](#112)        };
[113](#113)
[114](#114)        emitter.wr.write_str(quote_str)?;
[115](#115)        emitter.wr.write_str_lit(DUMMY_SP, &value)?;
[116](#116)        emitter.wr.write_str(quote_str)?;
[117](#117)
[118](#118)        Ok(())
[121](#121)    }
[122](#122)}

[136](#136)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span, false)?;
[137](#137)
[138](#138)        if emitter.cfg.minify {
[139](#139)            let value = if *self.value >= 10000000000000000_i64.into() {
[140](#140)                format!("0x{}", self.value.to_str_radix(16))
[141](#141)            } else if *self.value <= (-10000000000000000_i64).into() {
[142](#142)                format!("-0x{}", (-*self.value.clone()).to_str_radix(16))
[143](#143)            } else {
[144](#144)                self.value.to_string()
[145](#145)            };

[183](#183)
[184](#184)pub fn replace_close_inline_script(raw: &str) -> CowStr {
[185](#185)    let chars = raw.as_bytes();
[186](#186)    let pattern_len = 8; let mut matched_indexes = chars
[189](#189)        .iter()
[190](#190)        .enumerate()
[191](#191)        .filter(|(index, byte)| {
[192](#192)            byte == &&b'<'
[193](#193)                && index + pattern_len < chars.len()
[194](#194)                && chars[index + 1..index + pattern_len].eq_ignore_ascii_case(b"/script")
[195](#195)                && matches!(
[196](#196)                    chars[index + pattern_len],
[197](#197)                    b'>' | b' ' | b'\t' | b'\n' | b'\x0C' | b'\r'
[198](#198)                )
[199](#199)        })
[200](#200)        .map(|(index, _)| index)
[201](#201)        .peekable();
[202](#202)
[203](#203)    if matched_indexes.peek().is_none() {
[204](#204)        return CowStr::Borrowed(raw);
[205](#205)    }
[206](#206)
[207](#207)    let mut result = CompactString::new(raw);
[208](#208)
[209](#209)    for (offset, i) in matched_indexes.enumerate() {
[210](#210)        result.insert(i + 1 + offset, '\\');
[211](#211)    }
[212](#212)
[213](#213)    CowStr::Owned(result)
[214](#214)}

[216](#216)impl<W, S: swc_common::SourceMapper> Emitter<'_, W, S>

[221](#221)    pub fn emit_num_lit_internal(
[224](#224)        &mut self,
[225](#225)        num: &Number,
[226](#226)        mut detect_dot: bool,
[227](#227)    ) -> std::result::Result<bool, io::Error> {
[228](#228)        self.wr.commit_pending_semi()?;
[229](#229)
[230](#230)        self.emit_leading_comments_of_span(num.span(), false)?;
[231](#231)
[232](#232)        if num.value.is_infinite() && num.raw.is_none() {
[234](#234)            self.wr.write_str_lit(num.span, &num.value.print())?;
[235](#235)
[236](#236)            return Ok(false);
[237](#237)        }
[238](#238)
[239](#239)        let mut striped_raw = None;
[240](#240)        let mut value = String::default();
[241](#241)
[242](#242)        srcmap!(self, num, true);
[243](#243)
[244](#244)        if self.cfg.minify {
[245](#245)            if num.value.is_infinite() && num.raw.is_some() {
[246](#246)                self.wr.write_str_lit(DUMMY_SP, num.raw.as_ref().unwrap())?;
[247](#247)            } else {
[248](#248)                value = minify_number(num.value, &mut detect_dot);
[249](#249)                self.wr.write_str_lit(DUMMY_SP, &value)?;
[250](#250)            }
[251](#251)        } else {
[252](#252)            match &num.raw {
[253](#253)                Some(raw) => {
[254](#254)                    if raw.len() > 2 && self.cfg.target < EsVersion::Es2015 && {
[255](#255)                        let slice = &raw.as_bytes()[..2];
[256](#256)                        slice == b"0b" || slice == b"0o" || slice == b"0B" || slice == b"0O"
[257](#257)                    } {
[258](#258)                        if num.value.is_infinite() && num.raw.is_some() {
[259](#259)                            self.wr.write_str_lit(DUMMY_SP, num.raw.as_ref().unwrap())?;
[260](#260)                        } else {
[261](#261)                            value = num.value.print();
[262](#262)                            self.wr.write_str_lit(DUMMY_SP, &value)?;
[263](#263)                        }
[264](#264)                    } else if raw.len() > 2
[265](#265)                        && self.cfg.target < EsVersion::Es2021
[266](#266)                        && raw.contains('_')
[267](#267)                    {
[268](#268)                        let value = raw.replace('_', "");
[269](#269)                        self.wr.write_str_lit(DUMMY_SP, &value)?;
[270](#270)
[271](#271)                        striped_raw = Some(value);
[272](#272)                    } else {
[273](#273)                        self.wr.write_str_lit(DUMMY_SP, raw)?;
[274](#274)
[275](#275)                        if !detect_dot {
[276](#276)                            return Ok(false);
[277](#277)                        }
[278](#278)
[279](#279)                        striped_raw = Some(raw.replace('_', ""));
[280](#280)                    }
[281](#281)                }
[282](#282)                _ => {
[283](#283)                    value = num.value.print();
[284](#284)                    self.wr.write_str_lit(DUMMY_SP, &value)?;
[285](#285)                }
[286](#286)            }
[287](#287)        }
[288](#288)
[289](#289)        if !detect_dot {
[291](#291)            return Ok(false);
[292](#292)        }
[293](#293)
[294](#294)        Ok(striped_raw
[295](#295)            .map(|raw| {
[296](#296)                if raw.bytes().all(|c| c.is_ascii_digit()) {
[297](#297)                    let slice = raw.as_bytes();
[300](#300)                    if slice.len() >= 2 && slice[0] == b'0' {
[301](#301)                        return false;
[302](#302)                    }
[303](#303)
[304](#304)                    return true;
[305](#305)                }
[306](#306)
[307](#307)                false
[308](#308)            })
[309](#309)            .unwrap_or_else(|| {
[310](#310)                let bytes = value.as_bytes();
[311](#311)
[312](#312)                if !bytes.contains(&b'.') && !bytes.contains(&b'e') {
[313](#313)                    return true;
[314](#314)                }
[315](#315)
[316](#316)                false
[317](#317)            }))
[318](#318)    }

[320](#320)
[321](#321)pub fn encode_regex_for_ascii(pattern: &str, ascii_only: bool) -> CowStr {
[333](#333)    if !ascii_only || pattern.is_ascii() {
[334](#334)        return CowStr::Borrowed(pattern);
[335](#335)    }
[336](#336)
[337](#337)    let mut buf = CompactString::with_capacity(pattern.len());
[338](#338)
[339](#339)    for c in pattern.chars() {
[340](#340)        match c {
[341](#341)            '\x00'..='\x7e' => buf.push(c),
[343](#343)            '\u{7f}'..='\u{ff}' => {
[345](#345)                buf.push_str("\\x");
[346](#346)                write!(&mut buf, "{:02x}", c as u8).unwrap();
[347](#347)            }
[348](#348)            '\u{2028}' => buf.push_str("\\u2028"),
[350](#350)            '\u{2029}' => buf.push_str("\\u2029"),
[351](#351)            _ => {
[353](#353)                if c > '\u{FFFF}' {
[354](#354)                    let code_point = c as u32;
[356](#356)                    let h = ((code_point - 0x10000) / 0x400) + 0xd800;
[357](#357)                    let l = ((code_point - 0x10000) % 0x400) + 0xdc00;
[358](#358)                    write!(&mut buf, "\\u{h:04x}\\u{l:04x}").unwrap();
[359](#359)                } else {
[360](#360)                    write!(&mut buf, "\\u{:04x}", c as u16).unwrap();
[361](#361)                }
[362](#362)            }
[363](#363)        }
[364](#364)    }
[365](#365)
[366](#366)    CowStr::Owned(buf)
[367](#367)}
[368](#368)
[369](#369)macro_rules! cp {
[370](#370)    ($c:expr) => {
[371](#371)        unsafe { CodePoint::from_u32_unchecked($c as u32) }
[372](#372)    };
[373](#373)}
[374](#374)
[375](#375)const DOUBLE_QUOTE: CodePoint = cp!('"');
[376](#376)const SINGLE_QUOTE: CodePoint = cp!('\'');
[377](#377)const NULL_CHAR: CodePoint = cp!('\x00');
[378](#378)const BACKSPACE: CodePoint = cp!('\u{0008}');
[379](#379)const FORM_FEED: CodePoint = cp!('\u{000c}');
[380](#380)const LINE_FEED: CodePoint = cp!('\n');
[381](#381)const CARRIAGE_RETURN: CodePoint = cp!('\r');
[382](#382)const VERTICAL_TAB: CodePoint = cp!('\u{000b}');
[383](#383)const TAB: CodePoint = cp!('\t');
[384](#384)const BACKSLASH: CodePoint = cp!('\\');
[385](#385)const CTRL_START_1: CodePoint = cp!('\x01');
[386](#386)const CTRL_END_1: CodePoint = cp!('\x0f');
[387](#387)const CTRL_START_2: CodePoint = cp!('\x10');
[388](#388)const CTRL_END_2: CodePoint = cp!('\x1f');
[389](#389)const PRINTABLE_START: CodePoint = cp!('\x20');
[390](#390)const PRINTABLE_END: CodePoint = cp!('\x7e');
[391](#391)const DEL_START: CodePoint = cp!('\u{7f}');
[392](#392)const DEL_END: CodePoint = cp!('\u{ff}');
[393](#393)const LINE_SEPARATOR: CodePoint = cp!('\u{2028}');
[394](#394)const PARAGRAPH_SEPARATOR: CodePoint = cp!('\u{2029}');
[395](#395)const ZERO_WIDTH_NO_BREAK_SPACE: CodePoint = cp!('\u{FEFF}');
[396](#396)
[397](#397)const SURROGATE_START: CodePoint = cp!(0xd800);
[398](#398)const SURROGATE_END: CodePoint = cp!(0xdfff);
[399](#399)
[400](#400)pub fn get_quoted_utf16(v: &Wtf8, ascii_only: bool, target: EsVersion) -> (AsciiChar, CowStr) {
[402](#402)    if v.is_ascii() {
[405](#405)        let mut needs_escaping = false;
[406](#406)        let mut single_quote_count = 0;
[407](#407)        let mut double_quote_count = 0;
[408](#408)
[409](#409)        for &b in v.as_bytes() {
[410](#410)            match b {
[411](#411)                b'\'' => single_quote_count += 1,
[412](#412)                b'"' => double_quote_count += 1,
[413](#413)                0..=0x1f | b'\\' => {
[415](#415)                    needs_escaping = true;
[416](#416)                    break;
[417](#417)                }
[418](#418)                _ => {}
[419](#419)            }
[420](#420)        }
[421](#421)
[422](#422)        if !needs_escaping {
[423](#423)            let quote_char = if double_quote_count > single_quote_count {
[424](#424)                AsciiChar::Apostrophe
[425](#425)            } else {
[426](#426)                AsciiChar::Quotation
[427](#427)            };
[428](#428)
[429](#429)            if (quote_char == AsciiChar::Apostrophe && single_quote_count == 0)
[431](#431)                || (quote_char == AsciiChar::Quotation && double_quote_count == 0)
[432](#432)            {
[433](#433)                return (
[434](#434)                    quote_char,
[435](#435)                    CowStr::Borrowed(v.as_str().unwrap()),
[438](#438)                );
[439](#439)            }
[440](#440)        }
[441](#441)    }
[442](#442)
[443](#443)    let (mut single_quote_count, mut double_quote_count) = (0, 0);
[446](#446)    for c in v.code_points() {
[447](#447)        match c {
[448](#448)            SINGLE_QUOTE => single_quote_count += 1,
[449](#449)            DOUBLE_QUOTE => double_quote_count += 1,
[450](#450)            _ => {}
[451](#451)        }
[452](#452)    }
[453](#453)
[454](#454)    let quote_char = if double_quote_count > single_quote_count {
[456](#456)        AsciiChar::Apostrophe
[457](#457)    } else {
[458](#458)        AsciiChar::Quotation
[459](#459)    };
[460](#460)    let escape_char = if quote_char == AsciiChar::Apostrophe {
[461](#461)        AsciiChar::Apostrophe
[462](#462)    } else {
[463](#463)        AsciiChar::Quotation
[464](#464)    };
[465](#465)    let escape_count = if quote_char == AsciiChar::Apostrophe {
[466](#466)        single_quote_count
[467](#467)    } else {
[468](#468)        double_quote_count
[469](#469)    };
[470](#470)
[471](#471)    let capacity = v.len() + escape_count;
[473](#473)    let mut buf = CompactString::with_capacity(capacity);
[474](#474)
[475](#475)    let mut iter = v.code_points().peekable();
[476](#476)    while let Some(c) = iter.next() {
[477](#477)        match c {
[478](#478)            NULL_CHAR => {
[479](#479)                if target < EsVersion::Es5
[480](#480)                    || matches!(iter.peek(), Some(x) if *x >= cp!('0') && *x <= cp!('9'))
[481](#481)                {
[482](#482)                    buf.push_str("\\x00");
[483](#483)                } else {
[484](#484)                    buf.push_str("\\0");
[485](#485)                }
[486](#486)            }
[487](#487)            BACKSPACE => buf.push_str("\\b"),
[488](#488)            FORM_FEED => buf.push_str("\\f"),
[489](#489)            LINE_FEED => buf.push_str("\\n"),
[490](#490)            CARRIAGE_RETURN => buf.push_str("\\r"),
[491](#491)            VERTICAL_TAB => buf.push_str("\\v"),
[492](#492)            TAB => buf.push('\t'),
[493](#493)            BACKSLASH => buf.push_str("\\\\"),
[494](#494)            c if matches!(c.to_char(), Some(c) if c == escape_char) => {
[495](#495)                buf.push('\\');
[496](#496)                buf.push(c.to_char().unwrap());
[498](#498)            }
[499](#499)            c if c >= CTRL_START_1 && c <= CTRL_END_1 => {
[500](#500)                buf.push_str("\\x0");
[501](#501)                write!(&mut buf, "{:x}", c.to_u32() as u8).unwrap();
[502](#502)            }
[503](#503)            c if c >= CTRL_START_2 && c <= CTRL_END_2 => {
[504](#504)                buf.push_str("\\x");
[505](#505)                write!(&mut buf, "{:x}", c.to_u32() as u8).unwrap();
[506](#506)            }
[507](#507)            c if c >= PRINTABLE_START && c <= PRINTABLE_END => {
[508](#508)                buf.push(c.to_char().unwrap())
[510](#510)            }
[511](#511)            c if c >= DEL_START && c <= DEL_END => {
[512](#512)                if ascii_only || target <= EsVersion::Es5 {
[513](#513)                    buf.push_str("\\x");
[514](#514)                    write!(&mut buf, "{:x}", c.to_u32() as u8).unwrap();
[515](#515)                } else {
[516](#516)                    buf.push(c.to_char().unwrap());
[518](#518)                }
[519](#519)            }
[520](#520)            LINE_SEPARATOR => buf.push_str("\\u2028"),
[521](#521)            PARAGRAPH_SEPARATOR => buf.push_str("\\u2029"),
[522](#522)            ZERO_WIDTH_NO_BREAK_SPACE => buf.push_str("\\uFEFF"),
[523](#523)            c => {
[524](#524)                if c.is_ascii() {
[525](#525)                    buf.push(c.to_char().unwrap());
[527](#527)                } else if c > cp!('\u{FFFF}') {
[528](#528)                    if target <= EsVersion::Es5 {
[529](#529)                        let h = ((c.to_u32() - 0x10000) / 0x400) + 0xd800;
[530](#530)                        let l = (c.to_u32() - 0x10000) % 0x400 + 0xdc00;
[531](#531)                        write!(&mut buf, "\\u{h:04X}\\u{l:04X}").unwrap();
[532](#532)                    } else if ascii_only {
[533](#533)                        write!(&mut buf, "\\u{{{:04X}}}", c.to_u32()).unwrap();
[534](#534)                    } else {
[535](#535)                        buf.push(c.to_char().unwrap());
[538](#538)                    }
[539](#539)                } else if c >= SURROGATE_START && c <= SURROGATE_END {
[540](#540)                    write!(&mut buf, "\\u{:04X}", c.to_u32()).unwrap();
[543](#543)                } else if ascii_only {
[544](#544)                    write!(&mut buf, "\\u{:04X}", c.to_u32() as u16).unwrap();
[545](#545)                } else {
[546](#546)                    buf.push(c.to_char().unwrap());
[549](#549)                }
[550](#550)            }
[551](#551)        }
[552](#552)    }
[553](#553)
[554](#554)    (quote_char, CowStr::Owned(buf))
[555](#555)}
[556](#556)
[557](#557)pub fn minify_number(num: f64, detect_dot: &mut bool) -> String {
[558](#558)    'hex: {
[562](#562)        if num.fract() == 0.0 && num.abs() <= u64::MAX as f64 {
[563](#563)            let int = num.abs() as u64;
[564](#564)
[565](#565)            if int < 10000000 {
[566](#566)                break 'hex;
[567](#567)            }
[568](#568)
[569](#569)            if int % 1000 == 0 {
[571](#571)                break 'hex;
[572](#572)            }
[573](#573)
[574](#574)            *detect_dot = false;
[575](#575)            return format!(
[576](#576)                "{}{:#x}",
[577](#577)                if num.is_sign_negative() { "-" } else { "" },
[578](#578)                int
[579](#579)            );
[580](#580)        }
[581](#581)    }
[582](#582)
[583](#583)    let mut num = num.to_string();
[584](#584)
[585](#585)    if num.contains(".") {
[586](#586)        *detect_dot = false;
[587](#587)    }
[588](#588)
[589](#589)    if let Some(num) = num.strip_prefix("0.") {
[590](#590)        let cnt = clz(num);
[591](#591)        if cnt > 2 {
[592](#592)            return format!("{}e-{}", &num[cnt..], num.len());
[593](#593)        }
[594](#594)        return format!(".{num}");
[595](#595)    }
[596](#596)
[597](#597)    if let Some(num) = num.strip_prefix("-0.") {
[598](#598)        let cnt = clz(num);
[599](#599)        if cnt > 2 {
[600](#600)            return format!("-{}e-{}", &num[cnt..], num.len());
[601](#601)        }
[602](#602)        return format!("-.{num}");
[603](#603)    }
[604](#604)
[605](#605)    if num.ends_with("000") {
[606](#606)        *detect_dot = false;
[607](#607)
[608](#608)        let cnt = num
[609](#609)            .as_bytes()
[610](#610)            .iter()
[611](#611)            .rev()
[612](#612)            .skip(3)
[613](#613)            .take_while(|&&c| c == b'0')
[614](#614)            .count()
[615](#615)            + 3;
[616](#616)
[617](#617)        num.truncate(num.len() - cnt);
[618](#618)        num.push('e');
[619](#619)        num.push_str(&cnt.to_string());
[620](#620)    }
[621](#621)
[622](#622)    num
[623](#623)}
[624](#624)
[625](#625)fn clz(s: &str) -> usize {
[626](#626)    s.as_bytes().iter().take_while(|&&c| c == b'0').count()
[627](#627)}
[628](#628)
[629](#629)pub trait Print {
[630](#630)    fn print(&self) -> String;
[631](#631)}
[632](#632)
[633](#633)impl Print for f64 {
[634](#634)    fn print(&self) -> String {
[635](#635)        if *self == 0.0 {
[637](#637)            return self.to_string();
[638](#638)        }
[639](#639)
[640](#640)        let mut buffer = ryu_js::Buffer::new();
[641](#641)        buffer.format(*self).to_string()
[642](#642)    }
[643](#643)}

[9](#9)#[node_impl]
[10](#10)impl MacroNode for ObjectLit {
[11](#11)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[12](#12)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[13](#13)
[14](#14)        srcmap!(emitter, self, true);
[15](#15)
[16](#16)        punct!(emitter, "{");
[17](#17)
[18](#18)        let emit_new_line = !emitter.cfg.minify
[19](#19)            && !(self.props.is_empty() && is_empty_comments(&self.span(), &emitter.comments));
[20](#20)
[21](#21)        if emit_new_line {
[22](#22)            emitter.wr.write_line()?;
[23](#23)        }
[24](#24)
[25](#25)        let mut list_format =
[26](#26)            ListFormat::ObjectLiteralExpressionProperties | ListFormat::CanSkipTrailingComma;
[27](#27)
[28](#28)        if !emit_new_line {
[29](#29)            list_format -= ListFormat::MultiLine | ListFormat::Indented;
[30](#30)        }
[31](#31)
[32](#32)        emitter.emit_list(self.span(), Some(&self.props), list_format)?;
[33](#33)
[34](#34)        if emit_new_line {
[35](#35)            emitter.wr.write_line()?;
[36](#36)        }
[37](#37)
[38](#38)        srcmap!(emitter, self, false, true);
[39](#39)        punct!(emitter, "}");
[40](#40)
[41](#41)        Ok(())
[42](#42)    }

[198](#198)impl MacroNode for PropName {
[199](#199)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[200](#200)        match self {
[201](#201)            PropName::Ident(ident) => {
[202](#202)                emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(ident.span, false)?;
[204](#204)
[205](#205)                emitter.wr.commit_pending_semi()?;
[207](#207)
[208](#208)                srcmap!(emitter, ident, true);
[209](#209)
[210](#210)                if emitter.cfg.ascii_only {
[211](#211)                    if emitter.wr.can_ignore_invalid_unicodes() {
[212](#212)                        emitter.wr.write_symbol(
[213](#213)                            DUMMY_SP,
[214](#214)                            &crate::get_ascii_only_ident(&ident.sym, true, emitter.cfg.target),
[215](#215)                        )?;
[216](#216)                    } else {
[217](#217)                        emitter.wr.write_symbol(
[218](#218)                            DUMMY_SP,
[219](#219)                            &crate::get_ascii_only_ident(
[220](#220)                                &crate::handle_invalid_unicodes(&ident.sym),
[221](#221)                                true,
[222](#222)                                emitter.cfg.target,
[223](#223)                            ),
[224](#224)                        )?;
[225](#225)                    }
[226](#226)                } else {
[227](#227)                    emit!(ident);
[228](#228)                }
[229](#229)            }
[230](#230)            PropName::Str(ref n) => emit!(n),
[231](#231)            PropName::Num(ref n) => emit!(n),
[232](#232)            PropName::BigInt(ref n) => emit!(n),
[233](#233)            PropName::Computed(ref n) => emit!(n),
[234](#234)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[235](#235)            _ => return Err(unknown_error()),
[236](#236)        }
[237](#237)
[238](#238)        Ok(())
[239](#239)    }
[240](#240)}
[241](#241)
[242](#242)#[node_impl]
[243](#243)impl MacroNode for ComputedPropName {
[244](#244)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[245](#245)        srcmap!(emitter, self, true);
[246](#246)
[247](#247)        punct!(emitter, "[");
[248](#248)        emit!(self.expr);
[249](#249)        punct!(emitter, "]");
[250](#250)
[251](#251)        srcmap!(emitter, self, false);
[252](#252)
[253](#253)        Ok(())
[254](#254)    }

# stmt.rs - source

Source: https://rustdoc.swc.rs/src/swc_ecma_codegen/stmt.rs.html

[1](#1)use swc_common::Spanned;
[2](#2)use swc_ecma_ast::*;
[3](#3)use swc_ecma_codegen_macros::node_impl;
[4](#4)

[9](#9)#[node_impl]
[10](#10)impl MacroNode for Stmt {
[11](#11)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[12](#12)        match self {
[13](#13)            Stmt::Expr(ref e) => emit!(e),
[14](#14)            Stmt::Block(ref e) => {
[15](#15)                emit!(e);
[16](#16)                return Ok(());
[17](#17)            }
[18](#18)            Stmt::Empty(ref e) => emit!(e),
[19](#19)            Stmt::Debugger(ref e) => emit!(e),
[20](#20)            Stmt::With(ref e) => emit!(e),
[21](#21)            Stmt::Return(ref e) => emit!(e),
[22](#22)            Stmt::Labeled(ref e) => emit!(e),
[23](#23)            Stmt::Break(ref e) => emit!(e),
[24](#24)            Stmt::Continue(ref e) => emit!(e),
[25](#25)            Stmt::If(ref e) => emit!(e),
[26](#26)            Stmt::Switch(ref e) => emit!(e),
[27](#27)            Stmt::Throw(ref e) => emit!(e),
[28](#28)            Stmt::Try(ref e) => emit!(e),
[29](#29)            Stmt::While(ref e) => emit!(e),
[30](#30)            Stmt::DoWhile(ref e) => emit!(e),
[31](#31)            Stmt::For(ref e) => emit!(e),
[32](#32)            Stmt::ForIn(ref e) => emit!(e),
[33](#33)            Stmt::ForOf(ref e) => emit!(e),
[34](#34)            Stmt::Decl(Decl::Var(e)) => {
[35](#35)                emit!(e);
[36](#36)                semi!(emitter);
[37](#37)            }
[38](#38)            Stmt::Decl(e @ Decl::Using(..)) => {
[39](#39)                emit!(e);
[40](#40)                semi!(emitter);
[41](#41)            }
[42](#42)            Stmt::Decl(ref e) => emit!(e),
[43](#43)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[44](#44)            _ => return Err(unknown_error()),
[45](#45)        }
[46](#46)        if emitter.comments.is_some() {
[47](#47)            emitter.emit_trailing_comments_of_pos(self.span().hi(), true, true)?;
[48](#48)        }
[49](#49)
[50](#50)        if !emitter.cfg.minify {
[51](#51)            emitter.wr.write_line()?;
[52](#52)        }
[53](#53)
[54](#54)        Ok(())
[55](#55)    }
[56](#56)}

[234](#234)impl MacroNode for SwitchCase {
[235](#235)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[236](#236)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[237](#237)
[238](#238)        srcmap!(emitter, self, true);
[239](#239)
[240](#240)        if let Some(ref test) = self.test {
[241](#241)            keyword!(emitter, "case");
[242](#242)
[243](#243)            let starts_with_alpha_num = test.starts_with_alpha_num();
[244](#244)
[245](#245)            if starts_with_alpha_num {
[246](#246)                space!(emitter);
[247](#247)            } else {
[248](#248)                formatting_space!(emitter);
[249](#249)            }
[250](#250)
[251](#251)            emit!(test);
[252](#252)        } else {
[253](#253)            keyword!(emitter, "default");
[254](#254)        }
[255](#255)
[256](#256)        let emit_as_single_stmt = self.cons.len() == 1 && {
[257](#257)            self.is_synthesized()
[259](#259)                || self.cons[0].is_synthesized()
[260](#260)                || emitter
[261](#261)                    .cm
[262](#262)                    .is_on_same_line(self.span().lo(), self.cons[0].span().lo())
[263](#263)        };
[264](#264)
[265](#265)        let mut format = ListFormat::CaseOrDefaultClauseStatements;
[266](#266)        if emit_as_single_stmt {
[267](#267)            punct!(emitter, ":");
[268](#268)            space!(emitter);
[269](#269)            format &= !(ListFormat::MultiLine | ListFormat::Indented);
[270](#270)        } else {
[271](#271)            punct!(emitter, ":");
[272](#272)        }
[273](#273)        emitter.emit_list(self.span(), Some(&self.cons), format)?;
[274](#274)
[275](#275)        Ok(())
[276](#276)    }

[542](#542)#[node_impl]
[543](#543)impl MacroNode for IfStmt {
[544](#544)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[545](#545)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[546](#546)
[547](#547)        emitter.wr.commit_pending_semi()?;
[548](#548)
[549](#549)        srcmap!(emitter, self, true);
[550](#550)
[551](#551)        keyword!(emitter, "if");
[552](#552)
[553](#553)        formatting_space!(emitter);
[554](#554)        punct!(emitter, "(");
[555](#555)        emit!(self.test);
[556](#556)        punct!(emitter, ")");
[557](#557)        formatting_space!(emitter);
[558](#558)
[559](#559)        let is_cons_block = match *self.cons {
[560](#560)            Stmt::Block(..) => true,
[561](#561)            _ => false,
[562](#562)        };
[563](#563)
[564](#564)        emit!(self.cons);
[565](#565)
[566](#566)        if let Some(ref alt) = self.alt {
[567](#567)            if is_cons_block {
[568](#568)                formatting_space!(emitter);
[569](#569)            }
[570](#570)            keyword!(emitter, "else");
[571](#571)            if alt.starts_with_alpha_num() {
[572](#572)                space!(emitter);
[573](#573)            } else {
[574](#574)                formatting_space!(emitter);
[575](#575)            }
[576](#576)            emit!(alt);
[577](#577)        }
[578](#578)
[579](#579)        Ok(())
[580](#580)    }
[581](#581)}

[8](#8)use crate::unknown_error;
[9](#9)
[10](#10)impl<W, S: SourceMapper> Emitter<'_, W, S>
[11](#11)where
[12](#12)    W: WriteJs,
[13](#13)    S: SourceMapperExt,
[14](#14){
[15](#15)    pub(super) fn emit_class_decl_inner(
[16](#16)        &mut self,
[17](#17)        node: &ClassDecl,
[18](#18)        skip_decorators: bool,
[19](#19)    ) -> Result {
[20](#20)        self.emit_leading_comments_of_span(node.span(), false)?;
[21](#21)
[22](#22)        srcmap!(self, node, true);
[23](#23)
[24](#24)        if node.declare {
[25](#25)            keyword!(self, "declare");
[26](#26)            space!(self);
[27](#27)        }
[28](#28)
[29](#29)        if !skip_decorators {
[30](#30)            for dec in &node.class.decorators {
[31](#31)                emit!(self, dec);
[32](#32)            }
[33](#33)        }
[34](#34)
[35](#35)        if node.class.is_abstract {
[36](#36)            keyword!(self, "abstract");
[37](#37)            space!(self);
[38](#38)        }
[39](#39)
[40](#40)        keyword!(self, "class");
[41](#41)        space!(self);
[42](#42)        emit!(self, node.ident);
[43](#43)        emit!(self, node.class.type_params);
[44](#44)
[45](#45)        self.emit_class_trailing(&node.class)?;
[46](#46)
[47](#47)        Ok(())
[48](#48)    }
[49](#49)
[50](#50)    fn emit_var_decl_inner(&mut self, node: &VarDecl) -> Result {
[51](#51)        self.emit_leading_comments_of_span(node.span, false)?;
[52](#52)
[53](#53)        self.wr.commit_pending_semi()?;
[54](#54)
[55](#55)        srcmap!(self, node, true);
[56](#56)
[57](#57)        if node.declare {
[58](#58)            keyword!(self, "declare");
[59](#59)            space!(self);
[60](#60)        }
[61](#61)
[62](#62)        keyword!(self, node.kind.as_str());
[63](#63)
[64](#64)        let starts_with_ident = match node.decls.first() {
[65](#65)            Some(VarDeclarator {
[66](#66)                name: Pat::Array(..) | Pat::Rest(..) | Pat::Object(..),
[67](#67)                ..
[68](#68)            }) => false,
[69](#69)            _ => true,
[70](#70)        };
[71](#71)        if starts_with_ident {
[72](#72)            space!(self);
[73](#73)        } else {
[74](#74)            formatting_space!(self);
[75](#75)        }
[76](#76)
[77](#77)        self.emit_list(
[78](#78)            node.span(),
[79](#79)            Some(&node.decls),
[80](#80)            ListFormat::VariableDeclarationList,
[81](#81)        )?;
[82](#82)
[83](#83)        Ok(())
[84](#84)    }

[87](#87)#[node_impl]
[88](#88)impl MacroNode for Decl {
[89](#89)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[90](#90)        match self {
[91](#91)            Decl::Class(n) => emit!(n),
[92](#92)            Decl::Fn(n) => emit!(n),
[93](#93)            Decl::Var(n) => {
[94](#94)                emitter.emit_var_decl_inner(n)?;
[95](#95)                formatting_semi!(emitter);
[96](#96)                srcmap!(emitter, self, false);
[97](#97)            }
[98](#98)            Decl::Using(n) => emit!(n),
[99](#99)            Decl::TsEnum(n) => emit!(n),
[100](#100)            Decl::TsInterface(n) => emit!(n),
[101](#101)            Decl::TsModule(n) => emit!(n),
[102](#102)            Decl::TsTypeAlias(n) => emit!(n),
[103](#103)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[104](#104)            _ => return Err(unknown_error()),
[105](#105)        }
[106](#106)
[107](#107)        Ok(())
[108](#108)    }

# module_decls.rs - source

Source: https://rustdoc.swc.rs/src/swc_ecma_codegen/module_decls.rs.html

[1](#1)use swc_common::Spanned;
[2](#2)use swc_ecma_ast::*;
[3](#3)use swc_ecma_codegen_macros::node_impl;
[4](#4)
[5](#5)#[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[6](#6)use crate::unknown_error;
[7](#7)use crate::{util::StartsWithAlphaNum, ListFormat};
[8](#8)
[9](#9)#[node_impl]
[10](#10)impl MacroNode for ModuleDecl {
[11](#11)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[12](#12)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[13](#13)
[14](#14)        match self {
[15](#15)            ModuleDecl::Import(ref d) => emit!(d),
[16](#16)            ModuleDecl::ExportDecl(ref d) => emit!(d),
[17](#17)            ModuleDecl::ExportNamed(ref d) => emit!(d),
[18](#18)            ModuleDecl::ExportDefaultDecl(ref d) => emit!(d),
[19](#19)            ModuleDecl::ExportDefaultExpr(ref n) => emit!(n),
[20](#20)            ModuleDecl::ExportAll(ref d) => emit!(d),
[21](#21)            ModuleDecl::TsExportAssignment(ref n) => emit!(n),
[22](#22)            ModuleDecl::TsImportEquals(ref n) => emit!(n),
[23](#23)            ModuleDecl::TsNamespaceExport(ref n) => emit!(n),
[24](#24)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[25](#25)            _ => return Err(unknown_error()),
[26](#26)        }
[27](#27)
[28](#28)        emitter.emit_trailing_comments_of_pos(self.span().hi, true, true)?;
[29](#29)
[30](#30)        if !emitter.cfg.minify {
[31](#31)            emitter.wr.write_line()?;
[32](#32)        }
[33](#33)
[34](#34)        Ok(())
[35](#35)    }
[36](#36)}
[37](#37)
[38](#38)#[node_impl]
[39](#39)impl MacroNode for ExportDecl {
[40](#40)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[41](#41)        srcmap!(emitter, self, true);
[42](#42)
[43](#43)        match &self.decl {
[44](#44)            Decl::Class(decl) => {
[45](#45)                for dec in &decl.class.decorators {
[46](#46)                    emit!(dec);
[47](#47)                }
[48](#48)
[49](#49)                keyword!(emitter, "export");
[50](#50)
[51](#51)                space!(emitter);
[52](#52)                emitter.emit_class_decl_inner(decl, true)?;
[53](#53)            }
[54](#54)            _ => {
[55](#55)                keyword!(emitter, "export");
[56](#56)
[57](#57)                space!(emitter);
[58](#58)                emit!(self.decl);
[59](#59)            }
[60](#60)        }
[61](#61)
[62](#62)        Ok(())
[63](#63)    }
[64](#64)}
[65](#65)
[66](#66)#[node_impl]
[67](#67)impl MacroNode for ExportDefaultExpr {
[68](#68)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[69](#69)        srcmap!(emitter, self, true);
[70](#70)
[71](#71)        keyword!(emitter, "export");
[72](#72)
[73](#73)        space!(emitter);
[74](#74)        keyword!(emitter, "default");
[75](#75)        {
[76](#76)            let starts_with_alpha_num = self.expr.starts_with_alpha_num();
[77](#77)            if starts_with_alpha_num {
[78](#78)                space!(emitter);
[79](#79)            } else {
[80](#80)                formatting_space!(emitter);
[81](#81)            }
[82](#82)            emit!(self.expr);
[83](#83)        }
[84](#84)        semi!(emitter);
[85](#85)
[86](#86)        srcmap!(emitter, self, false);
[87](#87)
[88](#88)        Ok(())
[89](#89)    }

[116](#116)#[node_impl]
[117](#117)impl MacroNode for ImportDecl {
[118](#118)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[119](#119)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[120](#120)
[121](#121)        srcmap!(emitter, self, true);
[122](#122)
[123](#123)        keyword!(emitter, "import");
[124](#124)
[125](#125)        if self.type_only {
[126](#126)            space!(emitter);
[127](#127)            keyword!(emitter, "type");
[128](#128)        }
[129](#129)
[130](#130)        match self.phase {
[131](#131)            ImportPhase::Evaluation => {}
[132](#132)            ImportPhase::Source => {
[133](#133)                space!(emitter);
[134](#134)                keyword!(emitter, "source");
[135](#135)            }
[136](#136)            ImportPhase::Defer => {
[137](#137)                space!(emitter);
[138](#138)                keyword!(emitter, "defer");
[139](#139)            }
[140](#140)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[141](#141)            _ => return Err(unknown_error()),
[142](#142)        }
[143](#143)
[144](#144)        let starts_with_ident = !self.specifiers.is_empty()
[145](#145)            && match &self.specifiers[0] {
[146](#146)                ImportSpecifier::Default(_) => true,
[147](#147)                _ => false,
[148](#148)            };
[149](#149)        if starts_with_ident {
[150](#150)            space!(emitter);
[151](#151)        } else {
[152](#152)            formatting_space!(emitter);
[153](#153)        }
[154](#154)
[155](#155)        let mut specifiers = Vec::new();
[156](#156)        let mut emitted_default = false;
[157](#157)        let mut emitted_ns = false;
[158](#158)        for specifier in &self.specifiers {
[159](#159)            match specifier {
[160](#160)                ImportSpecifier::Named(ref s) => {
[161](#161)                    specifiers.push(s);
[162](#162)                }
[163](#163)                ImportSpecifier::Default(ref s) => {
[164](#164)                    emit!(s.local);
[165](#165)                    emitted_default = true;
[166](#166)                }
[167](#167)                ImportSpecifier::Namespace(ref ns) => {
[168](#168)                    if emitted_default {
[169](#169)                        punct!(emitter, ",");
[170](#170)                        formatting_space!(emitter);
[171](#171)                    }
[172](#172)
[173](#173)                    emitted_ns = true;
[174](#174)
[175](#175)                    assert!(self.specifiers.len() <= 2);
[176](#176)                    punct!(emitter, "*");
[177](#177)                    formatting_space!(emitter);
[178](#178)                    keyword!(emitter, "as");
[179](#179)                    space!(emitter);
[180](#180)                    emit!(ns.local);
[181](#181)                }
[182](#182)                #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[183](#183)                _ => return Err(unknown_error()),
[184](#184)            }
[185](#185)        }
[186](#186)
[187](#187)        if specifiers.is_empty() {
[188](#188)            if emitted_ns || emitted_default {
[189](#189)                space!(emitter);
[190](#190)                keyword!(emitter, "from");
[191](#191)                formatting_space!(emitter);
[192](#192)            }
[193](#193)        } else {
[194](#194)            if emitted_default {
[195](#195)                punct!(emitter, ",");
[196](#196)                formatting_space!(emitter);
[197](#197)            }
[198](#198)
[199](#199)            punct!(emitter, "{");
[200](#200)            emitter.emit_list(
[201](#201)                self.span(),
[202](#202)                Some(&specifiers),
[203](#203)                ListFormat::NamedImportsOrExportsElements,
[204](#204)            )?;
[205](#205)            punct!(emitter, "}");
[206](#206)            formatting_space!(emitter);
[207](#207)
[208](#208)            keyword!(emitter, "from");
[209](#209)            formatting_space!(emitter);
[210](#210)        }
[211](#211)
[212](#212)        emit!(self.src);
[213](#213)
[214](#214)        if let Some(with) = &self.with {
[215](#215)            formatting_space!(emitter);
[216](#216)            if emitter.cfg.emit_assert_for_import_attributes {
[217](#217)                keyword!(emitter, "assert");
[218](#218)            } else {
[219](#219)                keyword!(emitter, "with")
[220](#220)            };
[221](#221)            formatting_space!(emitter);
[222](#222)            emit!(with);
[223](#223)        }
[224](#224)
[225](#225)        semi!(emitter);
[226](#226)
[227](#227)        srcmap!(emitter, self, false);
[228](#228)
[229](#229)        Ok(())
[230](#230)    }
[231](#231)}
[232](#232)

[261](#261)        match self {
[262](#262)            ExportSpecifier::Default(..) => {
[263](#263)                unimplemented!("codegen of `export default from 'foo';`")
[264](#264)            }
[265](#265)            ExportSpecifier::Namespace(ref node) => emit!(node),
[266](#266)            ExportSpecifier::Named(ref node) => emit!(node),
[267](#267)            #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]

[298](#298)

[321](#321)#[node_impl]
[322](#322)impl MacroNode for NamedExport {
[323](#323)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[324](#324)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[325](#325)
[326](#326)        srcmap!(emitter, self, true);
[327](#327)
[328](#328)        struct Specifiers<'a> {
[329](#329)            has_namespace_spec: bool,
[330](#330)            namespace_spec: Option<&'a ExportNamespaceSpecifier>,
[331](#331)            has_named_specs: bool,
[332](#332)            named_specs: Vec<&'a ExportSpecifier>,
[333](#333)        }
[334](#334)        let Specifiers {
[335](#335)            has_namespace_spec,
[336](#336)            namespace_spec,
[337](#337)            has_named_specs,
[338](#338)            named_specs,
[339](#339)        } = self.specifiers.iter().fold(
[340](#340)            Specifiers {
[341](#341)                has_namespace_spec: false,
[342](#342)                namespace_spec: None,
[343](#343)                has_named_specs: false,
[344](#344)                named_specs: Vec::new(),
[345](#345)            },
[346](#346)            |mut result, s| match s {
[347](#347)                ExportSpecifier::Namespace(spec) => {
[348](#348)                    result.has_namespace_spec = true;
[349](#349)                    if result.namespace_spec.is_none() {
[351](#351)                        result.namespace_spec = Some(spec)
[352](#352)                    }
[353](#353)                    result
[354](#354)                }
[355](#355)                spec => {
[356](#356)                    result.has_named_specs = true;
[357](#357)                    result.named_specs.push(spec);
[358](#358)                    result
[359](#359)                }
[360](#360)            },
[361](#361)        );
[362](#362)
[363](#363)        keyword!(emitter, "export");
[364](#364)
[365](#365)        if self.type_only {
[366](#366)            space!(emitter);
[367](#367)            keyword!(emitter, "type");
[368](#368)        }
[369](#369)        formatting_space!(emitter);
[370](#370)
[371](#371)        if let Some(spec) = namespace_spec {
[372](#372)            emit!(spec);
[373](#373)            if has_named_specs {
[374](#374)                punct!(emitter, ",");
[375](#375)                formatting_space!(emitter);
[376](#376)            }
[377](#377)        }
[378](#378)        if has_named_specs || !has_namespace_spec {
[379](#379)            punct!(emitter, "{");
[380](#380)            emitter.emit_list(
[381](#381)                self.span,
[382](#382)                Some(&named_specs),
[383](#383)                ListFormat::NamedImportsOrExportsElements,
[384](#384)            )?;
[385](#385)            punct!(emitter, "}");
[386](#386)        }
[387](#387)
[388](#388)        if let Some(ref src) = self.src {
[389](#389)            if has_named_specs || !has_namespace_spec {
[390](#390)                formatting_space!(emitter);
[391](#391)            } else if has_namespace_spec {
[392](#392)                space!(emitter);
[393](#393)            }
[394](#394)            keyword!(emitter, "from");
[395](#395)            formatting_space!(emitter);
[396](#396)            emit!(src);
[397](#397)
[398](#398)            if let Some(with) = &self.with {
[399](#399)                formatting_space!(emitter);
[400](#400)                if emitter.cfg.emit_assert_for_import_attributes {
[401](#401)                    keyword!(emitter, "assert");
[402](#402)                } else {
[403](#403)                    keyword!(emitter, "with")
[404](#404)                };
[405](#405)                formatting_space!(emitter);
[406](#406)                emit!(with);
[407](#407)            }
[408](#408)        }
[409](#409)        semi!(emitter);
[410](#410)
[411](#411)        srcmap!(emitter, self, false);
[412](#412)
[413](#413)        Ok(())
[414](#414)    }
[415](#415)}
[416](#416)

[527](#527)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[528](#528)
[529](#529)        punct!(emitter, "`");
[530](#530)
[531](#531)        for i in 0..(self.quasis.len() + self.types.len()) {
[532](#532)            if i % 2 == 0 {
[533](#533)                emit!(self.quasis[i / 2]);
[534](#534)            } else {

[538](#538)            }

[564](#564)
[565](#565)        match &self.readonly {
[566](#566)            None => {}
[567](#567)            Some(tpm) => match tpm {
[568](#568)                TruePlusMinus::True => {
[569](#569)                    keyword!(emitter, "readonly");
[570](#570)                    space!(emitter);
[571](#571)                }
[572](#572)                TruePlusMinus::Plus => {
[573](#573)                    punct!(emitter, "+");
[574](#574)                    keyword!(emitter, "readonly");
[575](#575)                    space!(emitter);
[576](#576)                }
[577](#577)                TruePlusMinus::Minus => {
[578](#578)                    punct!(emitter, "-");
[579](#579)                    keyword!(emitter, "readonly");
[580](#580)                    space!(emitter);
[581](#581)                }
[582](#582)                #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[583](#583)                _ => return Err(unknown_error()),
[584](#584)            },
[585](#585)        }
[586](#586)
[587](#587)        punct!(emitter, "[");
[588](#588)
[589](#589)        emit!(self.type_param.name);
[590](#590)
[591](#591)        if let Some(constraints) = &self.type_param.constraint {
[592](#592)            space!(emitter);
[593](#593)            keyword!(emitter, "in");
[594](#594)            space!(emitter);
[595](#595)            emit!(constraints);
[596](#596)        }
[597](#597)
[598](#598)        if let Some(default) = &self.type_param.default {
[599](#599)            formatting_space!(emitter);
[600](#600)            punct!(emitter, "=");
[601](#601)            formatting_space!(emitter);
[602](#602)            emit!(default);
[603](#603)        }
[604](#604)
[605](#605)        if let Some(name_type) = &self.name_type {
[606](#606)            space!(emitter);
[607](#607)            keyword!(emitter, "as");
[608](#608)            space!(emitter);
[609](#609)            emit!(name_type);
[610](#610)        }
[611](#611)
[612](#612)        punct!(emitter, "]");
[613](#613)
[614](#614)        match self.optional {
[615](#615)            None => {}
[616](#616)            Some(tpm) => match tpm {
[617](#617)                TruePlusMinus::True => {
[618](#618)                    punct!(emitter, "?");
[619](#619)                }
[620](#620)                TruePlusMinus::Plus => {
[621](#621)                    punct!(emitter, "+");
[622](#622)                    punct!(emitter, "?");
[623](#623)                }
[624](#624)                TruePlusMinus::Minus => {
[625](#625)                    punct!(emitter, "-");
[626](#626)                    punct!(emitter, "?");
[627](#627)                }
[628](#628)                #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[629](#629)                _ => return Err(unknown_error()),
[630](#630)            },
[631](#631)        }
[632](#632)
[633](#633)        if let Some(type_ann) = &self.type_ann {
[634](#634)            punct!(emitter, ":");
[635](#635)            space!(emitter);
[636](#636)            emit!(type_ann);
[637](#637)        }
[638](#638)
[639](#639)        formatting_semi!(emitter);
[640](#640)
[641](#641)        emitter.wr.write_line()?;
[642](#642)        emitter.wr.decrease_indent()?;
[643](#643)        punct!(emitter, "}");
[644](#644)        Ok(())
[645](#645)    }
[646](#646)}
[647](#647)
[648](#648)#[node_impl]
[649](#649)impl MacroNode for TsMethodSignature {
[650](#650)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[651](#651)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[652](#652)
[653](#653)        if self.computed {
[654](#654)            punct!(emitter, "[");
[655](#655)            emit!(self.key);
[656](#656)            punct!(emitter, "]");
[657](#657)        } else {
[658](#658)            emit!(self.key)
[659](#659)        }
[660](#660)
[661](#661)        if self.optional {
[662](#662)            punct!(emitter, "?");
[663](#663)        }
[664](#664)
[665](#665)        if let Some(type_params) = &self.type_params {
[666](#666)            emit!(type_params);
[667](#667)        }
[668](#668)
[669](#669)        punct!(emitter, "(");
[670](#670)        emitter.emit_list(self.span, Some(&self.params), ListFormat::Parameters)?;
[671](#671)        punct!(emitter, ")");
[672](#672)
[673](#673)        if let Some(ref type_ann) = self.type_ann {
[674](#674)            punct!(emitter, ":");
[675](#675)            formatting_space!(emitter);
[676](#676)            emit!(type_ann);
[677](#677)        }
[678](#678)        Ok(())
[679](#679)    }
[680](#680)}

[695](#695)#[node_impl]
[696](#696)impl MacroNode for TsModuleDecl {
[697](#697)    fn emit(&mut self, emitter: &mut Macro) -> Result {
[698](#698)        emitter.emit_leading_comments_of_span(self.span(), false)?;
[699](#699)
[700](#700)        if self.declare {
[701](#701)            keyword!(emitter, "declare");
[702](#702)            space!(emitter);
[703](#703)        }
[704](#704)
[705](#705)        if self.global {
[706](#706)            keyword!(emitter, "global");
[707](#707)        } else {
[708](#708)            match &self.id {
[709](#709)                TsModuleName::Ident(_) => keyword!(emitter, "namespace"),
[712](#712)                TsModuleName::Str(_) => keyword!(emitter, "module"),
[713](#713)                #[cfg(swc_ast_unknown)]
[714](#714)                _ => return Err(unknown_error()),
[715](#715)            }
[716](#716)            space!(emitter);
[717](#717)            emit!(self.id);
[718](#718)        }
[719](#719)
[720](#720)        if let Some(mut body) = self.body.as_ref() {
[721](#721)            while let TsNamespaceBody::TsNamespaceDecl(decl) = body {
[722](#722)                punct!(emitter, ".");
[723](#723)                emit!(decl.id);
[724](#724)                body = &*decl.body;
[725](#725)            }
[726](#726)            formatting_space!(emitter);
[727](#727)            emit!(body);
[728](#728)        }
[729](#729)        Ok(())
[730](#730)    }
[731](#731)}

# basic_impl.rs - source

Source: https://rustdoc.swc.rs/src/swc_ecma_codegen/text_writer/basic_impl.rs.html

swc_ecma_codegen/text_writer/

basic_impl.rs[1](#1)use std::io::Write;
[2](#2)
[3](#3)use rustc_hash::FxBuildHasher;
[4](#4)use swc_allocator::api::global::HashSet;
[5](#5)use swc_common::{sync::Lrc, BytePos, LineCol, SourceMap, Span};
[6](#6)
[7](#7)use super::{Result, WriteJs};
[8](#8)
[9](#9)pub struct JsWriter<'a, W: Write> {
[16](#16)    indent: usize,
[17](#17)    indent_str: &'static str,
[18](#18)    line_start: bool,
[19](#19)    line_count: usize,
[20](#20)    line_pos: usize,
[21](#21)    new_line: &'a str,
[22](#22)    srcmap: Option<&'a mut Vec<(BytePos, LineCol)>>,
[23](#23)    srcmap_done: HashSet<(BytePos, u32, u32), FxBuildHasher>,
[24](#24)    pending_srcmap: Option<BytePos>,
[26](#26)    wr: W,
[27](#27)}
[28](#28)
[29](#29)impl<'a, W: Write> JsWriter<'a, W> {
[30](#30)    pub fn new(
[31](#31)        _: Lrc<SourceMap>,
[32](#32)        new_line: &'a str,
[33](#33)        wr: W,
[34](#34)        srcmap: Option<&'a mut Vec<(BytePos, LineCol)>>,
[35](#35)    ) -> Self {
[36](#36)        JsWriter {
[37](#37)            indent: Default::default(),
[38](#38)            indent_str: "    ",
[39](#39)            line_start: true,
[40](#40)            line_count: 0,
[41](#41)            line_pos: Default::default(),
[42](#42)            new_line,
[43](#43)            srcmap,
[44](#44)            wr,
[45](#45)            pending_srcmap: Default::default(),
[46](#46)            srcmap_done: Default::default(),
[47](#47)        }
[48](#48)    }
[49](#49)
[50](#50)    pub fn preamble(&mut self, s: &str) -> Result {
[51](#51)        self.raw_write(s)?;
[52](#52)        self.update_pos(s);
[53](#53)
[54](#54)        Ok(())
[55](#55)    }
[56](#56)
[57](#57)    pub fn set_indent_str(&mut self, indent_str: &'static str) {
[59](#59)        self.indent_str = indent_str;
[60](#60)    }
[61](#61)
[62](#62)    #[inline]
[63](#63)    fn write_indent_string(&mut self) -> Result {
[64](#64)        for _ in 0..self.indent {
[65](#65)            self.raw_write(self.indent_str)?;
[66](#66)        }
[67](#67)        if self.srcmap.is_some() {
[68](#68)            self.line_pos += self.indent_str.len() * self.indent;
[69](#69)        }
[70](#70)
[71](#71)        Ok(())
[72](#72)    }
[73](#73)
[74](#74)    #[inline]
[75](#75)    fn raw_write(&mut self, data: &str) -> Result {
[76](#76)        self.wr.write_all(data.as_bytes())?;
[77](#77)
[78](#78)        Ok(())
[79](#79)    }
[80](#80)
[81](#81)    #[inline(always)]
[82](#82)    fn write(&mut self, span: Option<Span>, data: &str) -> Result {
[83](#83)        if !data.is_empty() {
[84](#84)            if self.line_start {
[85](#85)                self.write_indent_string()?;
[86](#86)                self.line_start = false;
[87](#87)
[88](#88)                if let Some(pending) = self.pending_srcmap.take() {
[89](#89)                    self.srcmap(pending);
[90](#90)                }
[91](#91)            }
[92](#92)
[93](#93)            if let Some(span) = span {
[94](#94)                self.srcmap(span.lo());
[95](#95)            }
[96](#96)
[97](#97)            self.raw_write(data)?;
[98](#98)            self.update_pos(data);
[99](#99)
[100](#100)            if let Some(span) = span {
[101](#101)                self.srcmap(span.hi());
[102](#102)            }
[103](#103)        }
[104](#104)
[105](#105)        Ok(())
[106](#106)    }
[107](#107)
[108](#108)    #[inline]
[109](#109)    fn update_pos(&mut self, s: &str) {
[110](#110)        if self.srcmap.is_some() {
[111](#111)            let line_start_of_s = compute_line_starts(s);
[112](#112)            self.line_count += line_start_of_s.line_count;
[113](#113)
[114](#114)            let chars = s[line_start_of_s.byte_pos..].encode_utf16().count();
[115](#115)            if line_start_of_s.line_count > 0 {
[116](#116)                self.line_pos = chars;
[117](#117)            } else {
[118](#118)                self.line_pos += chars;
[119](#119)            }
[120](#120)        }
[121](#121)    }
[122](#122)
[123](#123)    #[inline]
[124](#124)    fn srcmap(&mut self, byte_pos: BytePos) {
[125](#125)        if byte_pos.is_dummy() && byte_pos != BytePos(u32::MAX) {
[126](#126)            return;
[127](#127)        }
[128](#128)
[129](#129)        if let Some(ref mut srcmap) = self.srcmap {
[130](#130)            if self
[131](#131)                .srcmap_done
[132](#132)                .insert((byte_pos, self.line_count as _, self.line_pos as _))
[133](#133)            {
[134](#134)                let loc = LineCol {
[135](#135)                    line: self.line_count as _,
[136](#136)                    col: self.line_pos as _,
[137](#137)                };
[138](#138)
[139](#139)                srcmap.push((byte_pos, loc));
[140](#140)            }
[141](#141)        }
[142](#142)    }
[143](#143)}
[144](#144)
[145](#145)impl<W: Write> WriteJs for JsWriter<'_, W> {
[146](#146)    #[inline]
[147](#147)    fn increase_indent(&mut self) -> Result {
[148](#148)        self.indent += 1;
[149](#149)        Ok(())
[150](#150)    }
[151](#151)
[152](#152)    #[inline]
[153](#153)    fn decrease_indent(&mut self) -> Result {
[154](#154)        self.indent -= 1;
[155](#155)        Ok(())
[156](#156)    }
[157](#157)
[158](#158)    #[inline]
[159](#159)    fn write_semi(&mut self, span: Option<Span>) -> Result {
[160](#160)        self.write(span, ";")?;
[161](#161)        Ok(())
[162](#162)    }
[163](#163)
[164](#164)    #[inline]
[165](#165)    fn write_space(&mut self) -> Result {
[166](#166)        self.write(None, " ")?;
[167](#167)        Ok(())
[168](#168)    }
[169](#169)
[170](#170)    #[inline]
[171](#171)    fn write_keyword(&mut self, span: Option<Span>, s: &'static str) -> Result {
[172](#172)        self.write(span, s)?;
[173](#173)        Ok(())
[174](#174)    }
[175](#175)
[176](#176)    #[inline]
[177](#177)    fn write_operator(&mut self, span: Option<Span>, s: &str) -> Result {
[178](#178)        self.write(span, s)?;
[179](#179)        Ok(())
[180](#180)    }
[181](#181)
[182](#182)    #[inline]
[183](#183)    fn write_param(&mut self, s: &str) -> Result {
[184](#184)        self.write(None, s)?;
[185](#185)        Ok(())
[186](#186)    }
[187](#187)
[188](#188)    #[inline]
[189](#189)    fn write_property(&mut self, s: &str) -> Result {
[190](#190)        self.write(None, s)?;
[191](#191)        Ok(())
[192](#192)    }
[193](#193)
[194](#194)    #[inline]
[195](#195)    fn write_line(&mut self) -> Result {
[196](#196)        let pending = self.pending_srcmap.take();
[197](#197)        if !self.line_start {
[198](#198)            self.raw_write(self.new_line)?;
[199](#199)            if self.srcmap.is_some() {
[200](#200)                self.line_count += 1;
[201](#201)                self.line_pos = 0;
[202](#202)            }
[203](#203)            self.line_start = true;
[204](#204)
[205](#205)            if let Some(pending) = pending {
[206](#206)                self.srcmap(pending)
[207](#207)            }
[208](#208)        }
[209](#209)
[210](#210)        Ok(())
[211](#211)    }

[287](#287)#[derive(Debug)]
[288](#288)struct LineStart {
[289](#289)    line_count: usize,
[290](#290)    byte_pos: usize,
[291](#291)}
[292](#292)fn compute_line_starts(s: &str) -> LineStart {
[293](#293)    let mut count = 0;
[294](#294)    let mut line_start = 0;
[295](#295)
[296](#296)    let mut chars = s.as_bytes().iter().enumerate().peekable();
[297](#297)
[298](#298)    while let Some((pos, c)) = chars.next() {
[299](#299)        match c {
[300](#300)            b'\r' => {
[301](#301)                count += 1;
[302](#302)                if let Some(&(_, b'\n')) = chars.peek() {
[303](#303)                    let _ = chars.next();
[304](#304)                    line_start = pos + 2
[305](#305)                } else {
[306](#306)                    line_start = pos + 1
[307](#307)                }
[308](#308)            }
[309](#309)
[310](#310)            b'\n' => {
[311](#311)                count += 1;
[312](#312)                line_start = pos + 1;
[313](#313)            }
[314](#314)
[315](#315)            _ => {}
[316](#316)        }
[317](#317)    }
[318](#318)
[319](#319)    LineStart {
[320](#320)        line_count: count,
[321](#321)        byte_pos: line_start,
[322](#322)    }
[323](#323)}

[337](#337)        let mut output = Vec::new();
[338](#338)        let mut writer = JsWriter::new(source_map, "\n", &mut output, None);
[339](#339)        writer.set_indent_str("\t");
[340](#340)        writer.increase_indent().unwrap();
[341](#341)        writer.write_indent_string().unwrap();
[342](#342)        writer.increase_indent().unwrap();

[19](#19)    (
[20](#20)        $fn_name:ident
[21](#21)        (

[69](#69)    fn write_punct(&mut self, span: Option<Span>, s: &'static str) -> Result {
[70](#70)        let bytes = s.as_bytes();
[71](#71)        if bytes.len() == 1 {
[72](#72)            let first = *unsafe { bytes.get_unchecked(0) };
[73](#73)            static PUNCT_TABLE: [bool; 256] = {
[74](#74)                let mut table = [false; 256];
[75](#75)                table[b'"' as usize] = true;
[76](#76)                table[b'\'' as usize] = true;
[77](#77)                table[b'[' as usize] = true;
[78](#78)                table[b'!' as usize] = true;
[79](#79)                table[b'/' as usize] = true;
[80](#80)                table[b'{' as usize] = true;
[81](#81)                table[b'(' as usize] = true;
[82](#82)                table[b'~' as usize] = true;
[83](#83)                table[b'-' as usize] = true;
[84](#84)                table[b'+' as usize] = true;
[85](#85)                table[b'#' as usize] = true;
[86](#86)                table[b'`' as usize] = true;
[87](#87)                table[b'*' as usize] = true;
[88](#88)                table
[89](#89)            };
[90](#90)            if PUNCT_TABLE[first as usize] {
[91](#91)                self.commit_pending_semi()?;
[92](#92)                return self.inner.write_punct(span, s);
[93](#93)            }
[94](#94)        }
[95](#95)        self.pending_semi = None;
[96](#96)        self.inner.write_punct(span, s)
[97](#97)    }
[98](#98)

[102](#102)    }

[110](#110)        if let Some(span) = self.pending_semi {
[111](#111)            self.inner.write_semi(Some(span))?;
[112](#112)            self.pending_semi = None;
